records.text:
# §A · ORIENTATION — the whole project in one page

> **Why this file is called GOOD-MORNING** *(Dave's framing — keep it, it explains the architecture)*
> **Memento.** Leonard has anterograde amnesia: every morning he reconstitutes himself from a record he
> built when he still remembered — Polaroids for working state, **tattoos for the facts he cannot afford
> to lose**. That is this project's operating model, not a metaphor for it. A session starts with no
> memory and rebuilds from artefacts.
>
> **The trust hierarchy is the tattoo/Polaroid distinction:** repo rules + runbooks + ledgers = tattoos
> (durable, survive any single rewrite) · `GOOD-MORNING` + `_LIVE-STATE` = Polaroids (working state,
> rewritten often) · the chat = gone by morning. **Never let a durable rule live only on a Polaroid.**
> *(Live example, 2026-07-22: this file said the tabs ruling was "NOT yet inscribed" — the ledger already
> carried R-D23 AND R-D24. The ledger was right. Read the ledger.)*
>
> **The real danger is not forgetting — it is confident false inscription.** Records carry provenance
> and confidence, not just content. Corrections get inscribed as loudly as the original claim. **Mark
> what was OBSERVED versus what was INFERRED.** The ritual stamps dates from `date`, never from belief.
> *(2026-07-22 afternoon instance: B-D7 was ruled in TWO beats — "shared 4%", reversed within the hour
> to pixel-true. BOTH are in the ledger, so the reversal can never read as agent drift.)*
>
> **The SECOND failure mode costs more: a stale READING of our own rules.** ⇒ **Before designing anything,
> CONSULT: `python3 knowledge/_consult.py "<what you're about to design>"`** (rules · rulings · assertions ·
> gates + where each bites). Runbook: `knowledge/_RUNBOOK-consult.md`. *(ds-009 CLOSED 2026-07-22: the
> corpus is now DISCOVERED — every `_proforma/_*-DECISIONS.md` indexes or the build fails.)*

> **STANDING SECTION — carry it into every handoff, from 2026-07-17 on.** At Dave's request:
> *"orientate a new starter — wider context helps."* New-starter style: assume the reader has no context.
> **Update it when the shape of the project changes, not every session — but never drop it, and never
> shorten it to a label.** *(Also step 2 of `_RUNBOOK-capture-ritual.md`; reachability-gated by
> `_validate_standing_instructions.py`.)*

records.head: ## What Apollo is
records.text:
## What Apollo is
A **governed design-system engine** for agentic UI generation. The bet: *generation is a commodity* — the value
is the layer around any generator. Two principles run through everything:
- **Retrieval, not recall.** Brand values are retrieved from token stores, so generated work can't drift off-brand.
  **Since ADR-0013 (built 2026-07-22) retrieval reaches RULES too:** organisms consume atoms' rule-blocks
  as generated partials — never re-type a sub-atom.
- **Verification = enforcement.** Judgment is encoded as **blocking gates**; "done" is withheld until they pass.
  If a rule isn't gated, assume it will be broken.

Tagline: **"lovable on rails."** Four phases: **Discover** → **Create** (what's being built now) → **Craft**
(the review-overlay docs ARE this) → **Dispatch**.

records.head: ## ★ ONE token store · ONE baseline library · FOUR themes (R-D15 → ADR-0011 → ADR-0014 → ★ ADR-0013)
records.text:
## ★ ONE token store · ONE baseline library · FOUR themes (R-D15 → ADR-0011 → ADR-0014 → ★ ADR-0013)
*Themes are **override sets at the semantic tier**; since ADR-0014 they carry **their own neutral primitive
ramps** through the **neutral DNA tier** (semantic roles alias `color/neutral/1–15`, never `color/mono/*`
directly; indices are SEMANTIC POSITIONS — SC remaps its anchor). **State mechanism is a THEME PROPERTY**
(registry `stateMechanism` + blocking snap gate). **★ Since ADR-0013, MOTION is a theme dial too (B-D7):**
`motion/press/{travel,darken}` — Mono carries the movement (pixel-true 2px), **Console inherits it**,
**Legacy + Supercharge zero it** (colour-only state feedback); tuning = a token edit, zero JS.
**Sibling pairs:** {Mono, Console} share neutrals/opacity/status/dataviz — Console FENCED (colour;
motion is inherited-not-fenced, flag if it should join); {Legacy, Supercharge} = structural siblings.*
The four themes (Dave's canonical order):
- **Apollo Legacy** — faithful reproduction of the existing HSBC system: brand red `#DB0011`, teals,
  `color/grey/*`. **AA-EXEMPT as-built (R-D24)**; explicit per-path overrides, no DNA tier, **no press movement**.
- **★ Apollo Mono** — the baseline we build NOW. "Very mono": colour ONLY in RAG status + dataviz.
  Neutral scale = `color/mono/1–15`; only red `#B92F1E` (status/RAG/dataviz). Carries the B-D7 press physics.
- **Apollo Console** — branded HSBC library. **LOCKED ≡ Mono** on neutrals/opacity/status/dataviz (fence);
  inherits Mono's motion; live divergence = rounded corners (radius overrides, values provisional).
- **Apollo Supercharge** — brand-uplift. **OWN warm ramp** `color/warm/1–15` (OBSERVED, Figma pull);
  states = COLOUR; **no press movement**; dark mode = provisional-agent, awaiting Dave.

records.head: ## Rules that actually bite (core + this session's)
records.text:
## Rules that actually bite (core + this session's)
- **CONSULT before designing** — then **survey before build**. *(This session the survey found Icon-button's
  physics was a REVIEWED refinement, not drift — which became B-D7.)*
- **★ ADR-0013 (BUILT): never re-type a sub-atom.** A registered partial's rule may exist ONLY in the
  atom's PARTIAL block or a generated AUTO-PARTIAL block — the ratchet gate blocks members' local
  re-implementations; the census lists everyone else's (accrete from OBSERVED duplication, ruling 3).
  Joining a family = markers + required vars + manifest binds + registry entry, and the generator
  fails loud on any missing piece.
- **★ B-D7: press physics is pixel-true and theme-dialable.** Travel/darken are TOKENS
  (`motion/press/*` → group caches); `--phys-size` is LOCAL geometry (buttons 120, icon 44); Legacy/SC
  zero the dial. **No JS in physics — ever** (Dave's constraint; DEF-003 posture). Tuning = token edit.
- **ADR-0014: semantic neutrals alias `color/neutral/*`, NEVER `color/mono/*` directly** · whites are
  classified (substrate → `neutral/15`; absolute → `color/white`, pinned).
- **ADR-0014: opacity states must SNAP** (`_validate_state_snap.py`, blocking, 7 checks incl. the
  text-state AA floor — inactive ≠ disabled).
- **Selftests are BUILD STEPS** — every new gate ships one AND wires it (partials + ratchet did).
- **Resurrect-verbatim is NOT gate-exempt** — the 273d18c~1 stepper's 13px/3px hit the grid gate on
  re-entry; corrected 12px/4px. Old reviewed artefacts re-enter through the same door as new work.
- **Grey-tint standing check** · **type26-013 (BLOCKING): white type is red-only** · **R-D6 glyph
  contrast by ROLE** · **`LEGACY_THEME_EXEMPTIONS`** (R-D24 — EXEMPTED, never passed).
- **canon.css** — generated only between AUTO markers; type.css HAND-AUTHORED. *(The ruling-4 gap is
  CLOSED: snippet RULE-text now self-heals into canon every build.)*
- **Every selector appended to `canon/type.css` is GLOBAL** — register in `_type-bindings.json` or the
  blast-radius gate fails.
- **Icons: real assets only** · **4px grid** · **sentence case** · **square corners in Mono** (radius =
  ROLE tokens, per-theme) · **weights: 100/300/400/500/700 only, NO 600.**
- **Derivation governance** — the engine never derives-and-promotes. **Promotion is Dave's alone.**
  *(SC dark values agent-derived → AWAIT him; B-D7's enacted values are HIS ruling, verbatim-quoted.)*
- **Spine discipline** — state lines in `_LIVE-STATE`; narrative >10 lines → `_DECISION-HISTORY/`.
- **Inscription prose is PARSER-VISIBLE** — no node names in ADR-header parentheticals (phantom edges).

## Standing instructions for the agent
- **Announce the model/routing split at the START of every substantive task** (`MODEL-ROUTING.md`).
- **Surface the chat names at BOTH ends — the small reliable thing Dave leans on, and it gets dropped
  (Dave flagged 2026-07-25).** At session START, offer the last handoff's "TITLE THE NEXT CHAT" as a
  ready-to-paste **"Rename this chat: …"**; at WRAP, put BOTH names at the top of `GOOD-MORNING.md`
  (ritual step 4b). Claude cannot rename chats itself — a name left unsurfaced is a label lost.
- **Verify before asking** (read repo / run gates) — including your own flags. **Reflect back before
  recording** a ruling — and when a ruling REVERSES, inscribe both beats (B-D7 is the model).
- **Decision-heavy / material-referring choices ship as review HTML** (`knowledge/_review/_make_review.py`
  — NOT at knowledge/ root). Architecture calls = the ADR-0012/0013/0014 model: options + firm
  recommendations in-chat, Dave rules by number, inscribe same hour, **feed the graph seed same hour**.
- **Surface spin-off candidates**; register ideas in `_FUTURE-STATE.md`. **Run the capture ritual
  unasked**; **stamp dates from `date`**. **Memory accelerates; the repo is the record.**
- **Stamp the context-gauge reading on every handoff artefact** — creator in `GOOD-MORNING` commit-state,
  workers in their receipt header — as a SCRUTINY indicator on that artefact (Red-authored ⇒ next reader
  re-verifies before trusting; not a quality score). Canon: `_RUNBOOK-context-gauge.md` § authoring-time stamp.

## Parallel-session model (PROVEN 2026-07-21)
On "read good morning", role is picked (Worker / Conductor / Solo) — **from Dave's opener line ONLY;
titles are labels.** ONE conductor = single writer for shared state; workers emit receipts to

rulings mid-flight — receipt verbatim.

records.head: ## How we work
records.text:
## How we work
- **The six-beat ladder (RULED #63-D1, Dave's wording — ledger § ★ #63):**
  **Retrieve** — the record first: quote it, never reconstruct (consult-receipts, `_memento_search`) ·
  **Research** — the world, when the record can't answer: desk research, dated, because external facts age ·
  **Analyse** — name the mechanism, not the symptom; verify the premise before building on it ·
  **Plan** — price it, sequence it, declare the stamp, decide delegation; every term tagged measured or estimated ·
  **Probe** — run the real system; measure, never recall ·
  **Test** — try to make your own conclusion fail; a green that can't fail is an assertion.
- **Review loop:** every doc ships **clean source + REVIEW copy** (`knowledge/_review/_make_review.py <file>`).
- **Live tuners beat static versions past ~2 colour round-trips.** Sheets read canon.css LIVE, never retype.
- **Dave commits via GitHub Desktop.** Claude commits in-sandbox per `_RUNBOOK-git-commit.md` — run it,
  don't improvise. `unable to unlink … *.lock` warnings = the delete-guard, not failure; judge by HEAD.
- **Comms:** exec summary + numbered next steps first, detail below.

## Batch 2026-08-16 #184

> **COMMIT STATE #183:** ONE commit, and it is this wrap's — the session's work landed **uncommitted** in the tree and is reconciled path by path on the banner at ⑧, never by a blind `git add -A`. ⛔ **NOT PUSHED — push is Dave's word only** (`_RUNBOOK-git-commit.md` step 5; the sandbox CAN push since #141, and that changes nothing about whose call it is). The `mcp__cowork__allow_cowork_file_delete` grant was already given this session, so the lock dance was not needed. **Context gauge at authoring: 🟡 AMBER — FILL 116,441 real of the 150,929 stop line (RELAYED by the conductor; a sub cannot measure the conductor's window).**

> ## ★ PRIOR — 2026-08-15 (Sat **#182**, FABLE conductor + **THREE OPUS build subs** + this OPUS wrap sub, Dave live throughout, **THREE RULINGS, DAVE'S — `s182-D1` · `s182-D2` · `s182-D3`** — ✅ **THE B3 REVIEW IS SETTLED AND THE SPARKLINE IS AN ATOM ALONE** · ★ **ITS STROKE IS SEMANTIC, NOT PICKED** · ⛔ **AND A FALSE "UNSCHEDULED" CLAIM WAS CAUGHT — READ ⓪ FIRST**)
>
> - ⛔ **⓪ THE FIRST FACT IS A CORRECTION TO OUR OWN RECORD, AND IT IS WRITTEN FIRST BECAUSE IT WAS CARRIED TWICE AS TRUTH.** The **#181 banner said the Monday dream-pass slot was "RULED BUT STILL UNSCHEDULED"** — *"offered TWICE now and answered neither time … so NOTHING was scheduled"* — and derived a second claim from it, that `s179-D1`'s return-with-numbers window had never opened. **BOTH WERE FALSE.** ✅ **The scheduler was LISTED LIVE (`list_scheduled_tasks`): `memento-dream-pass`, Sundays 07:10, ENABLED, lastRun 2026-08-15 07:13, nextRun 2026-08-16** (Dave also ran a manual pass on 08-15). **Dave caught it.** ★ **THE CLASS RULE, STATED IN CHAT AND INSCRIBED IN `s182-D1`'s EVIDENCE ARRAY RATHER THAN LEFT ON A ROLLING SURFACE: any claim that something is UNSCHEDULED must cite a scheduler-list RUN, exactly as a repo claim cites `git log`.** An unrun `list_scheduled_tasks` is indistinguishable from an absent schedule [[unrun-search-indistinguishable-from-absent-record]]; nothing could chase the claim because it was never true-then-false, it was simply never checked [[assertion-propagation-gap]]. The conductor corrected the memory hook in-window.
> - ✅ **① `s182-D1` — THE B3 GRADES REVIEW, FOUR CALLS, AND CALL 1 WAS REOPENED AND AMENDED LIVE.** Ruled off the deck `_REVIEW-B3-grades-2026-08-15-v1.html` (**the page writes nothing**; Dave pasted its compiled ruling message). He then **reopened call 1** — *"this might be wrong"* — alternatives were put in full (authoring convention · expiry dates · triage to the 49), and he landed on the park: *"no i think you are right"*. **CALL 1: probe commissioning is PARKED BEHIND THE FIRST-CYCLE NUMBERS — UNPROVABLE is accepted as an HONEST REGISTER, not a defect**; no probes are built until the return shows grades changing retrieval decisions, and if they earn their keep commissioning is scoped to the **starred/blocked 49, never all 122**. ★ **IMMEDIATELY IN FORCE — the probe-shaped-hooks AUTHORING CONVENTION: a new memory hook making a MECHANICAL claim must carry the backticked path or quotable line that makes it probeable**; judgment-shaped hooks stay honestly UNPROVABLE. **CALL 2:** the **30-day AGING threshold stays an EXPLICIT PLACEHOLDER**, picked not derived. **CALL 3:** the boot alert stands **AS BUILT** (counts only, STALE listed by name; **105 real per check-in, ~40 real per listed entry**). **CALL 4:** the counting window opens at the **FIRST SCHEDULED pass, 2026-08-16 07:10** — the 08-15 manual pass **does NOT count**.
> - ★ **② `s182-D2` — THE SPARKLINE IS AN ATOM, ALONE, AND DAVE RULED IT IN THREE REFINING BEATS OVER THE RENDER PROOFS.** Verbatim: **(1)** *"this doesn't need a title as it will usually live in a card"* · **(2)** *"this is just an atom"* · **(3)** *"the sparkline is an atom alone, the table cta can be optional in the trend card component"*. ⇒ the atom **sheds the `<details>` table disclosure entirely** — markup, CSS **and the table-hook `extraContract` added earlier the same session**. The table affordance becomes an **OPTIONAL element of a future trend-card component, in ICON-BUTTON form**, not a "View as table" label (his reasoning: a sparkline sits beside a headline figure, it is not an analysis tool; the accessible name survives as `aria-label`). ⬛ **FLOATED, NOT RULED, AND IT MUST NEVER BE LAUNDERED: the trend-card component itself** — *"might be a partially built trend card with option, I haven't decided yet"* [[feedback-dont-launder-a-premise-into-a-ruling]].
> - ★ **③ `s182-D3` — THE STROKE IS SEMANTIC, NOT PICKED, AND THE RULING DELETED THE QUESTION RATHER THAN ANSWERING IT.** Dave: *"the rules for colours should just follow the red and green ink colours for all themes"*; read back and confirmed — *"the read-back is correct"*. **DOWN = the ruled red ink, background-keyed per the two-red law `s151-D1` (`#DA1A00` on white / `#F6604C` else) · UP = the green that mirrors it (`s155-D1`, `#137F3C` / `#66CC8D`) · FLAT, verbatim: "the default ink near-black colours are fine for the neutrals, white on dark"** (`#1A1A1A` light / white dark). **Identical keying across all four themes — and that generalisation is a MEASUREMENT, not an assumption:** all three theme override files carry **zero** data/series entries, so per-theme keying reduces to background keying. ⛔ **NO VALUE WAS MINTED ANYWHERE** — every ink named is already ruled. **CONSEQUENCE: the tuner's 37-chip colour picker became MOOT** and the tuner re-scoped to scaling.
> - ✅ **④ DV-J2b (BUILD SUB 1) — AND ITS FIRST FINDING WAS THAT THE LANE RECEIPT WAS STALE.** The markup and CSS the lane was pointed at **already existed, and had since before #116** — the receipt described work as pending that was long landed [[roll-pointer-is-not-an-absence]]. The sub added the table-hook `extraContract` (**later removed by `s182-D2`, above**), **refused 4 mutations**, and **render-proved** the result. ⚠ Its build is superseded-in-part by the ruling it produced the evidence for; **the landed shape is the atom, not this**.
> - ✅ **⑤ BUILD SUB 2 — THE STRIP, AND THE NEW MACHINERY THAT MAKES THE STRIP LEGAL RATHER THAN MERELY DONE.** The atom was stripped per `s182-D2` (details block, title slot, lockup off; snippet **29,836 → 29,056 B**). ★ **NEW MACHINERY: a `markupExempt` clause in `knowledge/gen_component_partials.py` (+25 lines) — a mandatory partial may be absent ONLY BY NAMED-REASON EXEMPTION; 4 drives refused.** ⚠ **DECLARED GAP, NOT SMOOTHED: the clause has NO DURABLE SELFTEST BITE** — it was driven and it refused, and nothing in the gate chain will notice if it stops refusing tomorrow [[instrument-without-a-consumer]]. **Tuner v1 built** (37-chip picker + 4px/ramp snapline).
> - ✅ **⑥ BUILD SUB 3 — `s182-D3` ENACTED, AND THE TUNER LOST ITS HEADLINE FEATURE TO THE RULING.** Snippet **29,056 → 35,529 B** with semantic strokes (`rag/error-ink` `#DA1A00`/`#F6604C` · `rag/success-ink` `#137F3C`/`#66CC8D` · flat ink). **Tuner v2 (31,509 B) REMOVES THE PICKER ENTIRELY** and renders the semantic strokes live in both directions — **scaling is the ONLY open decision on it**. **All gates green**; type debt **1,101 → 1,099**, and ⚠ **the ratchet REWROTE `knowledge/_type_ratchet.json` wholesale — a MACHINE REFORMAT, declared so no reader reads intent into whitespace** [[serializer-defaults-reformat-the-file]].
> - ★ **⑦ THE FINDING INSIDE THE BUILD: THE GATE THAT CAUGHT THE TWO-RED MUTATION WAS NOT THE ONE WE WOULD HAVE NAMED.** A two-red mutation on the stroke was caught by **`_validate_snippets` via MANIFEST DRIFT** — **`dv-016` ALONE WOULD HAVE PASSED IT**. ⇒ the catch was an ACCOUNTING check, not a semantic one, and **a semantic stroke with no manifest binding would be UNGUARDED**. ⛔ **DECLARED, NOT BUILT** — `s172-D3`'s observed-failure rule: the finding is written down, the instrument is not built in the same breath [[green-tests-cannot-see-scope]].
> - ✅ **⑧ WHAT LANDED IN THE TREE, RECONCILED PATH BY PATH (11 modified + 3 new at wrap-open, plus this wrap's own ritual edits; ⛔ no blind `git add -A`).** **M:** `knowledge/_rulings.json` (the three rulings, inscribed by the conductor in-window) · `knowledge/_gardener.py` (schema block comment rewritten; selftests green) · `knowledge/component-types.json` · `knowledge/snippets/Chart-sparkline.reference.html` · `knowledge/gen_component_partials.py` (`markupExempt`) · `knowledge/_type_ratchet.json` (**machine reformat, declared**) · gate output docs `knowledge/_A11Y-GATE.md` + `knowledge/_DATAVIZ-GATE.md` · instrument appends `knowledge/_graph-mark-observations.jsonl`, `notes/_REHEARSAL-LOG.jsonl`, `notes/_dream/_GRADE-DECISIONS.jsonl` (**declared**). **NEW:** `_REVIEW-B3-grades-2026-08-15-v1.html` · `reviews/SPARKLINE-ATOM-TUNER-2026-08-15-v1.html` · `-v2.html`. ⚠ **ONE DECLARED DELTA AGAINST THE BRIEF: `knowledge/_SNIPPET-AUDIT.md` was named as expected-dirty and is CLEAN in `git status`** — reported as observed, not reconciled away.
> - ⚙ **⑨ GAUGE — RELAYED BY THE CONDUCTOR (a sub cannot measure the conductor's window).** boot **55,807 real** — **INSIDE** the `s171-D1` band, read from `knowledge/_gauge_tokens.py` rather than from a hook. **FILL at wrap-open 135,908 real — a FLOOR, late by one step, DECLARED — vs the stop line 150,929** ⇒ **room 15,021 against a 42–49K conductor wrap**, which is **why this wrap is delegated** [[stop-line-repriced-93]]. > ## ★ PRIOR — 2026-08-15 (Sat **#176**, FABLE conductor + **FOUR OPUS build/measurement subs** + this OPUS wrap sub, Dave live throughout, **TWO RULINGS, BOTH DAVE'S** — **THE STEP TRACKERS INHERIT THE SUCCESS ROUNDELS** · ✅ **"INK" IS NOW A RULED PRINCIPLE** · ⛔ **THE FINDING: THE MONO AND CONSOLE STEPS PAINTED *NOTHING* AT HEAD** · ⛔ **A SELFTEST CLAUSE THAT COULD ONLY FIRE AFTER ANOTHER ASSERTION FAILED** · ⚠ **THE INSCRIPTION ITSELF TOOK `_governs` FROM 7 FAILS TO 14**)
>
> - ⚠ **⓪ THE DATE SEAM, DECLARED FIRST BECAUSE IT IS THE KIND OF THING THAT ROTS SILENTLY.** The session ran **2026-08-14** and both rulings carry that date; this wrap ran after midnight and **every stamp it writes is taken from `date` — 2026-08-15**. Neither date is wrong; the seam is written down rather than harmonised, because quietly reconciling two clocks is how a false inscription of something as small as a date gets made.
> - ✅ **① `s176-D1` — THE INK PRINCIPLE, RULED, AND IT DISCHARGES `s175-D1`(f)'s OPEN GENERALISATION.** Quoted from the entry, not paraphrased: *"'BLACKEST INK' RESOLVES PER THEME, AND IT IS THE BLACKEST INK THAT ISN'T PURE BLACK, TO AVOID HALATION."* Dave verbatim: *"the simple rule for ink is the blackest ink that isn't pure black, to avoid halation. #13110E for SC / #1a1a1a for Mono and console I think, that might not be right / #333333 for Legacy"* — ★ **he hedged Mono/Console, and the hedge was resolved by VERIFYING AGAINST THE TOKEN STORE BEFORE the read-back, not after**: Mono ink `mono/4` **#1A1A1A** (R-D16) · Console LOCKED = Mono (R-D25) · Supercharge `warm/2` **#13110E** (ADR-0014 anchor remap) · Legacy body ink Grey 8 **#333333** (col25-011). ⛔ **NO VALUE CHANGES — the store already embodied the principle; the ruling adds the PRINCIPLE and its RATIONALE (halation), neither previously recorded.** Confirmed firm: *"yes this is fine"*. Evidence: `knowledge/_rulings.json` § `s176-D1` (**155 → 156**).
> - ✅ **② `s176-D2` — STEP TRACKERS ADOPT THE SUCCESS-ROUNDEL SYSTEM WHOLESALE, RULED BY EYE OFF THREE LIVE REVIEW PAGES.** Dave: *"exactly the same system that we use for the success roundels on all, they can just inherit then wholesale."* **(a)** `step/complete` **aliases `rag/success`** — the roundel chain — so themes inherit: Mono **#66CC8D** · Console/SC **#5DAC7B**, mode-invariant. **(b) LEGACY EXCEPTION: PRIMARY red #DB0011 light / #FFFFFF dark.** ★ **The sequence is recorded because the CORRECTIONS are the record:** *"the red"* → *"warning red"* → *"Legacy error, sorry my mistake"* (#A8000B) → **off the v1 page**, *"Use the primary red for Legacy"* (#DB0011, FINAL). Dark = white **SUPERSEDES `s175-D1`'s Legacy red-both-modes, BY HIS WORD** (*"both are true"*). **(c) GLYPHS:** thick tick (canon `yes-thick.svg`) for all; Mono/Console/SC tick = dark ink **#1A1A1A** matching each theme's roundel mark (`s122-D2`/`D3`); **`step/on-complete` MINTED**. **(e) LEGACY BAR:** `progress/complete` override **#333333 light / #FFFFFF dark** — the `s176-D1` Legacy ink applied to the bar, **declared per the fall-through class**. **(f)** the Legacy dark tick **#1A1A1A** is a **DECLARED EXCEPTION** taken by the build (an exact roundel-mark match would be white-on-white, forbidden by his own doctrine) — accepted by ratification of the v2 page. **(g) MINTED WITH EYES OPEN:** *"There will be reviews by others later so some changes might be made in the future, thats just the process. lets get these in for now!"* — ⛔ **ratified AS-BUILT with future revision EXPECTED; that is not a hedge on firmness**, and the name `step/on-complete` stands under the same clause. Evidence: `knowledge/_rulings.json` § `s176-D2` (**156 → 157**).
> - ★ **③ `s176-D2`(d) — THE CONTRAST DOCTRINE IS NOW DAVE'S RULED RATIONALE, NOT AN AGENT'S JUDGMENT CALL.** His verbatim: *"the intent/meaning is carried by the glyph a label, therefor the track and the roundels it is less important that they have Ally contrast. the label and the symbol must carry the contrast not the decoration."* ⇒ the **gated legs** are tick-on-fill + label and **all pass** (**5.22–8.77** / **12.63–17.45**); **fill-on-page and fill-on-track are DECLARED ABSENCES with that rationale attached**. ★ **This is what resolves the six sub-3:1 light fill cells and the two-session-old fill-on-track finding — BY DOCTRINE, not by moving a value**, which is exactly the shape `s160-D2` and `s151-D2` already established.

Fixed and **mutation-proven** (receipt 5 of the refinement sub). ★ Same family as #175 ⑧ and as `[107]`: the enforcement tier was not the problem — the **reachability** was.

Caught by `git diff` **before commit**, reverted, redone as a **TEXTUAL tail insertion**. ⛔ Reported as a HIT, not as a near-miss: [[serializer-defaults-reformat-the-file]] says round-trip byte-identical BEFORE writing, and the first attempt did not.

It is the top mechanical item on the residual.

A DATAPOINT OUTSIDE THE BAND, DECLARED — never corrected into it, and never used to re-base a constant** [[boot-floor-measured-109]] [[invariant-cannot-discriminate-reversal]]. **FILL at wrap-open ~131,000 vs the stop line 150,929** ⇒ **~20K of room against a 42–49K conductor wrap ⇒ DELEGATED, on the arithmetic rather than after it bit** [[stop-line-repriced-93]]. Job window = FILL − boot ≈ **73.6K real**, rung **`M`** (⛔ edges DERIVED at build, never hand-banded), **sub spend EXCLUDED** per `s168-D2`. **`subs 603941 tokens (n=4)`** — 77,576 + 127,464 + 186,874 + 212,027; ⚠ **this wrap sub's own spend is EXCLUDED and UNKNOWABLE at write time and is NOT estimated in** [[feedback-measuring-tool-must-not-guess]]. ⚠ **AND A DISCREPANCY IN THE BRIEF IS DECLARED RATHER THAN RECONCILED: its prose says THREE build subs while FOUR figures were given and `n=4` was instructed.** The line reports what was measured; **the count of subs is reported as given, not adjudicated** — the fourth is most likely the step-colour CONTROLLER sub that made finding ④, but that is a reading, not a measurement. **Environment: `tiktoken` needed installing cold.**

> - ✅ **① CHAIN-DIET-2 — THE POST-WRAP CORRECTION BLOAT IS A CLASS, AND IT IS NAMED.** #168 was a delegated wrap and Dave ruled **twice after it closed** (`#168-A`, then `s168-D5`); each correction was made **in place on the banner line**, which is right [[read-chain-is-where-staleness-is-free]] and expensive — three blocks accreted and the read chain paid at every boot. **HOMED BY ADDITION** at `notes/_MEMENTO-DECISIONS.md` § ★ #169 CHAIN-DIET-2, **then cut** [[home-by-addition-then-cut]]: title line **879 → 64 tape** (cap 120, `#60-D8`) · chain **15,709 → 13,629 tape** · index rebuilt · rehearsal **0 structural fails**. ★ **The class: post-wrap rulings on a DELEGATED wrap multiply in-place corrections, and the digest belongs at the NEXT opener, not at the end of the wrap that caused them.** Evidence: commit `e8ed189` · `notes/_MEMENTO-DECISIONS.md` § ★ #169 CHAIN-DIET-2 · chat #169 2026-08-13 (live).

Diagnosed here: the VM's disks held **~2G of caches from OLD sessions owned by DEFUNCT uids** (they resolve as `nobody`) — **undeletable from inside**, and a **VM restart did NOT recycle them**. EXIT CHECK: every ⚠/⬛ in the #60 banner maps to ledger § ★ #60 (D1–D8), DO-FIRST 9/10, or §C·4; its "TWO GATES CANNOT FAIL" item is CLOSED by #63 (`816f726`) with the CI survey step as its structural guard.

Two retirement receipts, same batch: DO-FIRST items 10 and 14 were UPDATED IN PLACE at the #63 wrap (10: matrices 4/5 drafted; 14: FILED — #63-D1 ruled, §A inscribed). Superseded texts verbatim:

> **10. PER-GATE TEST PLAN, STILL OWED.** For each Memento gate: what it CLAIMS · what proves it BITES · what mutation makes it RED · what it structurally CANNOT SEE — apply it, gate by gate. [born #59 · guards: this line · until: run]

> **14. ⬛ DAVE'S FOUNDING PRINCIPLE — EXTENDED BY HIM #62, PLACEMENT NOW SHAPED, WORDING STILL HIS:** *"we research, we analyse, we probe, we test"* **+ his #62 additions: PLAN (price · sequence · stamp · delegation) and DESK RESEARCH when appropriate (the world, not just the record — dated, because external facts age).** Six-beat ladder proposed: RETRIEVE → RESEARCH → ANALYSE → PLAN → PROBE → TEST, each beat mapped to existing machinery (consult-receipts · dated survey notes · premise-verification · pre-flight formula · the survey · the bite matrix). **#63 drafts it into §A "How we work" + the brief template (four headers: RESEARCHED · MECHANISM · PROBED · FALSIFIER, + PLAN stamp) + the one-pager's opening — inscribed only on his word.** [born #59 · copied up #62 · extended #62 · guards: this line · until: Dave rules the wording at #63]

> **COMMIT STATE (stamped 2026-07-31 from `date`; CORRECTED post-wrap, MEASURED against `origin/master..HEAD`):** ✅ tree CLEAN, every mid-window diff named before staging. **3 local, UNPUSHED, Desktop-owed: `ace3ed3` `18c7789` `168649c` (#62).** ⚠ This line briefly said "7 unpushed" — the opener's "#61's five are unpushed" premise had AGED by boot (Dave had already pushed `e3cd04b`…`4b634eb`); inscribed on trust, caught at the final control, corrected in the 5b addendum beat. Chain freshness enforced at the commit seam — all #62 commits passed `_git_commit.sh`'s `_gen_chain.py --check`.

> ## ★ PRIOR — 2026-07-31 (Fri **#60**, OPUS conductor + 2× SONNET workers, Dave live throughout — ★★ **DELEGATION IS MEASURED AT 46:1 AND DAVE'S THIRD TERM HAS A NUMBER** · ⛔ **TWO GATES CANNOT FAIL WHERE IT COUNTS** · ⬛ **MULTI-WINDOW SETTLED — TWO USE CASES, CAP 3**)
> **pre-flight #60 (DECLARED AT THE OPENER, before any job — the first genuinely prospective stamp in the record):** boot **61,775 MEASURED** + job **41,779 MEASURED** + wrap **42,434 ESTIMATED** (#59's measurement, carried as a FLOOR — it was still climbing when stamped) = **145,988 of 200,000 — 🟢 GREEN** against the 160,000 amber threshold. Stop line **132,955** = `200,000 − 42,434 wrap − 24,611 step (MEASURED, high end, this window)`. ★ **Dave's #59 formula applied as ruled — reserve the HIGH end of both terms — and it bound the window to ~29,000 of usable job, which is what actually shaped the session.** ⚠ **The band word is QUOTED from `_gauge_tokens.py`, never recalled** — #59 stamped RED from memory and its own gate caught it; the same trap, declined this time.
> **⚠ SHORT BY DESIGN — rulings and every figure → `notes/_MEMENTO-DECISIONS.md` § ★ #60 and the #60 stratum below.**
> - **★★ THE GATE BIT — ON THE CONDUCTOR'S OWN RATIFIED TEXT, AT THE CLOSE OF A SESSION SPENT ASKING WHETHER GATES BITE.** `_capture_gate.py --wrap` returned **exit 1, 2 fail / 8 warn**, rejecting this very pre-flight stamp: no `wrap` term, no band word. ★★ **We spent the window unable to prove bite by probing green — and proved it by writing something wrong.** ⇒ **the mutation test the tranche owes was run by accident, and the pre-flight FORM gate PASSES it.** ⚠ **Scope, stated honestly: this proves the FORM check bites. It says nothing about whether pre-flight can detect a FALSE number — it cannot, and that remains #60-D-open.**
> - **★★ BOOT IS CLOSED BY REPRODUCTION, NOT BY A READING.** #58b **61,582** · #59 **61,812** · #60 **61,775** — three independent measurements, spread **240**. ⇒ **`ds-025` item 1's ±8,000 harness hole is CLOSED.** ★ **One reading falsified the claim that fill was unobservable; it took THREE to make boot a constant you can budget against.** Boot is **31% of the working budget spent before a single decision** — Dave named this the recurring cost, and it is now a number rather than a feeling.
> - **★★ DELEGATION MEASURED AT ~46:1 — DAVE'S THIRD TERM, WHICH HAD NEVER BEEN MEASURED, NOW HAS A NUMBER.** brief-out **~4,259 real** (MEASURED as the `cache_creation` of the launching turn; **an UPPER bound — it carries the conductor's own prose too**) · report-in **~2,000 real** (MEASURED-PARTIAL, lands one record beyond the last read) · **conductor cost ~6,300** against **293,169 subagent tokens** (156,158 + 137,011, from the workers' own usage). ⇒ **~46 tokens of work per token of conductor budget.** ★ **This is the term Dave named as cheapest to fix because both directions are text you can count exactly — and that turned out to be true.**
> - **★★ A CARELESS `Glob` COST 24,611 REAL — 59% OF THIS WINDOW'S JOB SPEND, AND 4× THE ENTIRE DELEGATION ROUND-TRIP.** One unanchored wildcard returned 100 session paths when exactly one was needed. **Declared, not hidden.** ★ **The lesson is not "be careful" — it is that ONE sloppy retrieval outweighs the entire cost of conducting two workers, so retrieval discipline dominates delegation overhead by a wide margin.**
> - **⛔ TWO GATES CANNOT FAIL WHERE IT COUNTS — `check-after-its-own-remedy` IS STILL LIVE AND IS NOW LOCATED TO THE LINE.** `_build_all.py:184-186` runs `_gen_chain.py` (write) then `--check` back-to-back; `_build_memento_index.py` gets the identical write-then-check pairing at `_build_all.py:160-161`. **CI (`.github/workflows/gates.yml:29`) runs only `_build_all.py` ⇒ BOTH are tautologically green in CI regardless of real staleness.** Chain staleness has **exactly ONE genuine seam** — `_git_commit.sh:60`, local-only, and `.git/hooks/` holds only samples so nothing forces its use. **Index freshness has ZERO genuine seam anywhere:** `index_freshness_check` runs only inside `--wrap`, which neither `_build_all.py`, `_git_commit.sh`, nor CI ever invokes — **it fires only if a session types the flag by hand.** ⚠ **UNFIXED — §C.**
> - **⚠ THE STRATA GATE BOUNDS COUNT, NEVER BYTES — AND BOTH GATES ASSUME THE OTHER COVERS MAGNITUDE.** `charged_line_counts` (`_capture_gate.py:1310-1318`) subtracts the WHOLE stratum region — exempt and live blocks together — from §C's charge, while the strata gate bounds only live-block COUNT. ⇒ **a single block, live or exempt, can grow without bound, invisible to both simultaneously.** ★★ **A new failure shape: not a gap between two gates, but a gap each gate believes the other closes.**
> - **★ PRE-FLIGHT IS NOW UPGRADEABLE FROM SELF-CONSISTENT TO TRUE — NOT BUILT.** The gate only regexes self-reported numbers for internal arithmetic; **it never independently measures, so any internally-coherent fiction passes.** The fill is now PROVEN readable from `message.usage` ⇒ **the gate can check the stamp against the transcript instead of against itself.** ⬛ **The cheapest real bite available in the suite.**
> - **⚠ BOOT IS MAJORITY-UNACCOUNTED, AND THE PERCENTAGES ARE NOT MEASUREMENTS.** ~**13,600 tape** located of an estimated ~39,600; **residual 65.6%** is system prompt + eager tool schemas, which **the transcript never logs** (zero `systemPrompt` and zero `input_schema` hits — checked directly). ★★ **CAUGHT IN REPLAY: the worker DERIVED its denominator by dividing 61,775 real by 1.559 — the exact unit-conversion this corpus forbids.** Tape figures are DIRECT; **every % is SOFT.** ⇒ *a table can be honest in its cells and wrong in its column.*
> - **★ CONFIG BEATS REPO AS THE BOOT LEVER — the opposite of the standing assumption.** skills **3,393** + deferred tool names **2,686** + MCP instructions **1,896** = **7,975 tape, all CONFIG-controlled**, against `MEMORY.md` **5,141 repo-controlled**. ⇒ **disabling one unused MCP plugin beats trimming the memory index.** ⚠ **`AGENTS.md` is MEASURED-ABSENT from boot** — 1,858 tape in the repo, never loaded.
> - **⬛ DAVE RULED — MULTI-WINDOW IS SETTLED, AND IT HAS TWO USE CASES, NOT ONE.** Available for **(i) catching up the weekly quota** AND **(ii) cranking production when we need it**. **Claude OFFERS; Dave chooses or vetoes.** **Cap 3** — *"I find them difficult to manage beyond 3"* — **revisable upward as his confidence grows.** ⇒ **this RETIRES the CONTESTED clause standing since #48 and disputed at #57.** ★ **The clause was never about tokens: Dave's decision load is what binds, and a measured stop line is what made the cap manageable.**
> - **⚠ `$?` AFTER `| tail` REPORTED `EXIT=0` FOR A CHECK THAT HAD REFUSED — caught in-window, before it entered the record.** `_gen_chain.py --check` **REFUSES rather than estimating** when tiktoken is absent from a fresh sandbox — *"a MEASUREMENT REFUSAL, not a content verdict in either direction."* ★ **The measuring tool behaved correctly and my reading of it did not.** Installed tiktoken; the refusal path is sound and should be left alone.

> ## ★ PRIOR — 2026-07-27 (Mon **afternoon #9**, OPUS solo self-conducting, effort MAX — ★ **ds-019 WITHDRAWN WITH CAUSE: THERE IS NO OVERRIDING RULE, AND THERE NEVER WAS** · ★ **the defect was the INSTRUMENT — a computed value read in the SAME TASK as the class change is the PRE-transition value** · ★ **`oklab(0 0 0 / 0)` is an IN-FLIGHT INTERPOLATION, not a failed declaration** · ★ **the predecessor probe's control WAS WORKING and was overruled as a string artefact** · ★ **DV-D17's render-proof UNBLOCKED · Dave's screenshot question ANSWERED** · harness given a REPO HOME by Dave's ruling · build untouched **60/60 GREEN** · 🔴 ~63% by his "headline only" call): **A false defect spent one full session as canon, and the record was directing the next window to hunt a rule that does not exist.**
> - **★ ds-019 IS NOT A DEFECT.** `.dv-legrow.is-solo` **(0,2,0) at cascade index 4** beats `.dv-legrow` **(0,1,0) at index 3** — CDP `getMatchedStylesForNode`, no `!important`, no inline, no `attributesStyle`, no keyframes, **no `:is()`/`:where()` or `#cb4-legend li` rule.** Confirmed in **six contexts**: snippet @1180/@760 · showroom light pane @1180/@760 · showroom **dark** pane @1180/@760 (theme-tracks correctly — `--ink` `#FFFFFF`, 6% white). **The census that found only four `dv-legrow` selectors was right; the premise it answered was false.**
> - **★ THE MECHANISM, measured as a time series.** `.dv-legrow` carries `transition: border-color var(--ease), background var(--ease)` = **0.16s**. Before add: `rgb(225,225,225)` / `rgba(0,0,0,0)` · **t=0 same task: `rgb(225,225,225)` / `oklab(0 0 0 / 0)`** ← *exactly the pair ds-019 recorded as proof* · t≈50ms: `rgb(145,145,145)` / `oklab(0.217785 … / 0.0241082)` **(mid-interpolation)** · **t≈150ms+: `rgb(26,26,26)` = `--ink` ✓ / 6% ink ✓.** **It paints from ~160ms.**
> - **★ THE HARDEST PART: THE PREDECESSOR'S POSITIVE CONTROL WAS WORKING.** It saw `oklab(0 0 0 / 0)` differ from `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)` and passed — and those **genuinely are different states** (transitioning-transparent vs static-transparent). Session #8 diagnosed its own control as a string-comparison defect and **dismissed a true signal**. The string method was bad *and* its verdict was right. ⇒ **When a control fires unexpectedly, exhaust "it detected something real" BEFORE concluding it is broken.** Sibling of [[gate-narrows-its-own-rule]] and #7's stale suite — **the instrument present, correct-looking, and not measuring what it claimed** — except this one **got inscribed into the corpus as a defect and began directing work.**

- ⚠ **`s165-D4` PER-LINE LINK RATIFICATION, 6/37 — TITLED TWICE (#168, #169), STARTED NEITHER TIME, ZERO ROWS MOVED.** Said plainly; ⚠ **reported, never acted on — what to do is DAVE'S** [[premise-ages-faster-than-rule]].

**Landed (evidence per claim, re-driven first-hand by this wrap sub unless marked RELAYED):**

- ✅ **THE +1 WAS ATTRIBUTED BEFORE IT WAS RULED ON, AND THE FIRST THING THE ATTRIBUTION DID WAS ACQUIT THE INSTRUMENT.** A **per-file inventory diff** of the #119 baseline content against now found **every file byte-identical except `knowledge/canon/canon.css` (279 → 280 rows)**, with **both eras' validators identical in verdict** — so the +1 is a real content change, not instrument drift [[attribute-the-diff]]. The offending row is a **TYPE-001** (*“does not pull canon/type.css”*), and `git log -S` names the drop commit: **`49ef4cb` (#122, 2026-08-07)**, which removed **two inert `<link … type.css>` strings from a comment block inside a `.css` file**.
- ✅ **THE FINDING IS MENTION-VS-USE, AND IT IS WHY OPTION 1 WAS THE RECOMMENDATION.** A `.css` file has **no legal way to pull `type.css`** — a stylesheet cannot carry a `<link>`. So TYPE-001's only-ever “pass” on `canon.css` was **an inert string in a comment**, and ★ **a gate satisfied by MENTION is not a gate** [[gate-must-quote-what-it-forbids]]. Restoring the string would have restored a **fake pass**; raising the baseline would have paid for it in permanent debt.
- ✅ **`s166-D1` — DAVE'S RULING, TAKEN FROM A THREE-OPTION CHOICE.** Options put to him: **(1)** scope TYPE-001 to HTML · **(2)** restore the inert string · **(3)** raise the baseline. The browser is fine; **the call boundary is the limit** — and unlike the fence it replaces, this one is measured.

What remains true is that **CI still excludes them**: `.github/workflows/gates.yml` **`:20`–`:22`**, re-read first-hand and quoted — *"The render-dependent checks (`_validate_state_contrast.py`, `_validate_screen.py --render`) are NOT run here — they need a browser engine."* ⇒ **`s152-D1`'s proof now has a runner in the sandbox but still none in CI.**

That would give the browser arms a runner in CI as well as in the sandbox. ⛔ **Put to Dave as a proposal; his call, not this sub's** [[feedback-dont-launder-a-premise-into-a-ruling]].
- ⛔ **THIS AMENDMENT RULES NOTHING.** `s153-D1` (green/success-ink) stays **FLOATED, AWAITING DAVE'S CONFIRMATION** — the SHAPE only, **the two values are NOT ruled and are NOT invented here**, and it stays in `_FUTURE-STATE.md` and **deliberately out of `knowledge/_rulings.json`**. If nothing wears it, the comparison is **SKIPPED**. ★ The presence test compares **COMPUTED STRINGS, never `parse()`** — parsing every descendant would MINT REFUSALS this change was not ruled to create, and the delta would stop being attributable [[attribute-the-diff]]. ★ **It keys on PAINTED, not on the colour black:** a genuine black roundel still fails, and that is a fixture, not a promise.
- ✅ **THE SKIP IS DECLARED, NEVER SILENT — AND IT MOVES NO COUNT DAVE RATIFIED.** New `kind:'markskip'` record (`where`/`fill`/`reason`); new `MARKSKIP_PREFIX = "- 🟡 MARK SKIP (declared, s152-D1)"` at **`:512`**, **deliberately NOT one of the counted prefixes**; surfaced in `render_report` as a section bit and a body line. **`verify_report`'s three counter contracts are UNTOUCHED — verified first-hand, not relayed:** the entire diff (**+127/−5**) REMOVES only two lines, `if(fg){` and the old `_measure_fixtures()` signature. ★ A gate that quietly stops reporting is indistinguishable from a gate that was fixed [[enactment-register-adr-0016]].
- ✅ **3 FIXTURES · 4 ARMS · A MUTATION CONTROL.** Fixtures at **`:832`/`:842`/`:849`** — `mark_phantom_fill_is_skipped`, `mark_real_black_roundel_still_fails` (**the discriminating one**), `mark_body_only_in_defs_is_skipped`. No root (dpkg lock), disk **97% / 360M free** (re-measured — **worse** than the 95%/499M relayed). **The gate REFUSING is it working as designed, and it is NOT a pass.** ⚠ **AND CI DOES NOT RUN IT EITHER** — `.github/workflows/gates.yml:20`–`:22`, read first-hand: the render-dependent checks are explicitly excluded. ✅ The **FIX** does have a runner, confirmed first-hand: `_build_all.py:255` (gate) and `:261` (`--selftest`). ⇒ ★ **A sharper instance of [[instrument-without-a-consumer]]: the FIX has a consumer; the PROOF does not.** Only Dave's local render path can close it.

A session running only that form would have inscribed a true-sounding falsehood about its own environment, from an honest gate. Cause: **bash calls carry no env, so the install survives on disk while the PATH TO IT does not survive a call boundary** [[sandbox-call-boundary-kills]]. ★ **AND 18 PURE ARMS RUN AND PASS IN-SANDBOX TODAY** (`grep -c "^  ok "` = 18, in **both** runs) — first-hand corroboration that residual ② is cheap and real. **Landed (evidence per claim):**

- ✅ **① FONTCONFIG OUT OF THE TREE — ENACTED AND DRIVEN. Residual ① from #137 is closed except one declared gap.** The permanent fix is a `/var/tmp` **symlink farm**: `ln -s` each repo `.ttf` into `/var/tmp/fonts-<session>/`, point fontconfig's `<dir>` at the farm, so its `.uuid` directory-identity marker lands outside the repo. ~5 KB of links, so it preserves the ENOSPC constraint that forced #136's change rather than reopening it. Enacted in `knowledge/_RUNBOOK-render-verify.md` as a new `§ SYMLINK FARM (#138)` block, addition-only; #129's and #136's blocks stand as history, with a pointer marking the `<dir>`→repo element on `:42`/`:46` SUPERSEDED.
- ★ **② PREMISE REPRODUCED FIRST-HAND BEFORE ANY FIX.** `fc-cache` against a conf whose `<dir>` is the repo TTF dir wrote `.uuid`, `.uuid.LCK`, `.uuid.TMP-SpeXCi` — the same three names #136 left (`.TMP` suffix is random; #136 got `NpSPVs`). `git status --untracked-files=all` flagged all three.
- ✅ **③ DRIVEN THREE WAYS, WITH A MUTATION THAT DISCRIMINATES.** (A) farm conf from a clean dir → **0** repo strays · (B) mutation, only `<dir>` swapped back to the repo, everything else identical → **3** strays, so the test CAN fail · (C) after cleanup → **0**.
- ✅ **④ REAL RENDER RUN, AND THE FACE STILL RENDERS.** `showroom/chart-bar.html`, `goto file://` (`set_content()` is banned) — at 1180 and 480, identical at both widths: `HSBC_MtUnivers_Latin` **347** · `Univers Next HSBC` (type.css `--uf`) **347** · `Univers Next for HSBC` (snippet `--font`) **347** · `DejaVu Sans` control **375** · nonexistent-face control **301**. Both aliases land on the target and NOT on the fallback number. Repo strays after the render: **0**.

Regenerated: 4,384 → **5,623 tape**.
- **★★ WHY THIRTEEN SESSIONS OF GATES DID NOT CATCH IT — THE DETECTOR SITS DOWNSTREAM OF THE FIX.** `_gen_chain.py --check`'s only caller was `_build_all.py:176`, and `_build_all.py:174` **regenerates the file immediately before it** ⇒ inside a build the check is fresh by construction and can only ever catch **nondeterminism in `build()`**, never disk staleness. The comment above it (lines 172–173) states the right intent — *"--check is BLOCKING here on purpose … a stale copy is the #32 defect with the blast radius maximised"* — from a position that cannot deliver it. ★ [[instruction-right-cause-wrong]], and [[instrument-without-a-consumer]]: **a check placed after its own remedy cannot fail.**

- **LIVE:** `knowledge/_render/verify_chart_text_render.py` — NEW. Asserts (A) every SVG `<text>`'s **INK** sits inside the viewBox · (B) no two ink boxes intersect. Measurement is split by axis and the split IS the design: baseline ← `getStartPositionOfChar(0).y` (exact, never inferred) · horizontal ← `getBBox()` (laid-out truth, carries letter-spacing; ~1u conservative) · vertical ← canvas ink scan (the only place the em box is catastrophically wrong). The standing licensed-cut assertion structurally cannot see it.** Blast radius MEASURED: `verify_dv_j2_render.py` uses `set_content`; its assertions (toggle 32px, hit 44×44) are identical both ways so **#27's verdict STANDS** — but its label rendered 12px vs 13.33px, i.e. it stands by luck, not design.

- **★★ DV-D17 — ENACTED · DOM-PROVEN · ✅ RENDER-PROVEN.** `knowledge/_render/verify_dv_d17_render.py`. Licensed HSBC cut asserted **inside the frame being measured**, transitions killed **before the first gesture** (ds-019's lesson, structurally), **real pointer clicks on the real gestures** (LABEL = isolate · SWATCH = check on) — never `classList.add`, which is not a user path. **Six contexts, identical:** snippet @1180/@760 · showroom **light** @1180/@760 · showroom **dark** @1180/@760 (verified genuinely dark — `--ink` `#FFFFFF`, `--line` `#808080` — so it is coverage, not one pane counted twice). **baseline** `rgb(225,225,225)` / `rgba(0,0,0,0)` → **isolated** `rgb(26,26,26)` = `--ink` + `color(srgb 0.101961 … / 0.06)` = 6% ink → **released** back to `rgb(225,225,225)` / `rgba(0,0,0,0)`.
- **★ THE FINDING — A ONE-SIDED PROOF OF AN ABSENCE IS NOT A PROOF.** The specified test was *"no `.dv-legrow` resolves the `.is-solo` treatment after isolate-then-check-on."* That is satisfied by a working fix, a blind probe, a mistyped selector **and a complete revert**. Session #8 ran it and printed `24 checks · 0 failures` while measuring nothing. **The replacement is two-sided in ONE gesture sequence: step 1 proves the treatment CAN be seen (isolate → it paints); step 2 proves it stops.** Step 1 is what makes step 2 mean anything — and it is precisely the half the original lacked. **Generalises past this defect: any proof whose assertion is "X is absent" needs a paired proof that X is detectable when present.**
- **★ THE BITE REPRODUCES DAVE'S SCREENSHOT.** `--bite` on a **neutered COPY** (216-byte DV-D17 release branch deleted; canon untouched, `git status` clean): step 2 fails at both widths with row 1 keeping `.is-solo`, `rgb(26,26,26)` border and 6% ink fill **while three series show** — the black-bordered "B Savings" Dave reported. **Step 1 still passes under the neuter**, which is the whole point: the probe is not blind, the behaviour is broken.

Fixed by parking the pointer **and** carrying an OBSERVED `hovered` field, so a hovered row is **named and skipped, never silently filtered**. *(A control that fires may be RIGHT — exhaust that before calling it broken. Here it was right about the pixels and wrong about the cause, and only an observed field could separate the two.)*

## ⏱ PRIOR DELTA — 2026-07-27 (Mon **afternoon #8**, OPUS solo self-conducting, effort MAX — ★ **ds-018 CONFIRMED BY MEASUREMENT: it is the LOOKUP, and it is INSTANCE FIVE — a FORM-tier token consumed from a DATAVIZ-tier scope, never resolved since the day it landed** · ★ **ds-019 NEW: `.dv-legrow.is-solo` MATCHES, its vars RESOLVE, and it STILL does not paint — so DV-D17's owed render-proof is VACUOUS and would have read green forever** · ★ **MY OWN PROBE PRINTED 24 CHECKS / 0 FAILURES AND WAS WRONG** — the positive control compared computed colours as STRINGS · **NOTHING BUILT, Dave chose log-and-stop at the fork** · build unchanged **60/60 GREEN**) — "The proof was green because the thing it was watching for has never happened, and could never happen."

- **★ ds-018 — HYPOTHESIS PROVEN, COMPETING EXPLANATION ELIMINATED, BY MEASUREMENT NOT BY READING CSS** (which is what the entry demanded). `getComputedStyle` on the **disabled** Reset, licensed HSBC cut, `document.fonts.check` asserted true FIRST, **four contexts — snippet AND showroom pane (via `page.frames`), at 1180 and 760** — all four identical: **`--border-disabled` → `""` (does not resolve)** · **`--text-disabled` → `""`** · `--ink` → `#1A1A1A` (resolves, so the context is not broken) · **`border-color` → `rgb(26,26,26)` = ink = the `:hover` value** · `color` → `rgb(26,26,26)`. ⇒ IACVT → `border-color` falls to `currentColor`, `color` falls to `inherit`; **both roads end at ink.**
- **★ AND THE CENSUS IS STRONGER THAN THE MEASUREMENT: the token is not set to an ink-ish value, it is NOT SET AT ALL where a chart can see it.** `canon.css` declares `--border-disabled` **29×**, on ten **form** scopes (`.cn-input-fields` · `.cn-dropdown` · `.cn-amount-input` · `.cn-date-picker` · `.cn-date-range-picker` · `.cn-file-upload` · `.cn-form-layout` · `.cn-secure-entry` · `.cn-textarea` · `.cn-time-picker`) + their SC/dark twins — **ZERO on any chart scope, ZERO on `:root`**. The four consuming snippets (`Chart-bar`/`combo`/`donut`/`line`) declare it **0×** and use it 1× — same for `--text-disabled`. ⇒ **A FORM-TIER TOKEN READ FROM A DATAVIZ-TIER SCOPE. It has never resolved on a chart, in any theme, at any width, and every gate was green throughout.**
- **⚠ THE FIX IS WIDER THAN THE SYMPTOM DAVE REPORTED.** `--text-disabled` fails in the same breath and is **masked** (colour is inherited, so it lands on ink, which *reads* plausible) — a fix aimed only at `border-color` leaves a second silent lookup live. Belongs in the **generator + a gate**, never a `canon.css` hand-patch (block is replicated per chart family and regenerated). **Two gate candidates, neither built:** the entry's own *no control's disabled treatment may resolve to its hover treatment* · **and the cheaper, wider one — fail loud when a declaration references a custom property that resolves nowhere in its own scope** (the *fail-loud-on-unknown* shape already ratified for `dv-vocab`). ⚠ **CONFIRMED ≠ FIXED.**
- **★ ds-019 NEW — AND IT IS THE FINDING THAT STOPPED THE WINDOW.** Applying `.is-solo` **directly**, no gestures, no behaviour code: element **matches** `.dv-legrow.is-solo` ✓ · `--ink` → `#1A1A1A` ✓ · `--line` → `#E1E1E1` ✓ · yet computed **`border-color` → `rgb(225,225,225)`** (= `--line`; the declaration did not win) and **`background` → `oklab(0 0 0 / 0)` = FULLY TRANSPARENT**, not 6% ink. **Control: the identical `color-mix` written literally on a sibling `<div>` in the SAME subtree → `color(srgb 0.101961 0.101961 0.101961 / 0.06)`** — the mix itself is fine. **A rule that matches, whose variables resolve, overridden on BOTH declarations.** The census enumerated only selectors containing `dv-legrow` (4, none able to beat `(0,2,0)`) ⇒ **the winning rule does not contain that string** — `:is()`/`:where()`, `.dv-leg > li`, `#cb4-legend li`, `!important`, inline/animated all plausible, **none checked. DO NOT GUESS IT.**
- **⚠⚠ CONSEQUENCE: DV-D17's RENDER-PROOF IS UNATTAINABLE AS SPECIFIED AND WOULD HAVE READ GREEN FOREVER.** The acceptance test is *"no `.dv-legrow` resolves the `.is-solo` treatment after isolate-then-check-on"*. **No row resolves it at ANY time** — before, during, or after isolation — so the assertion is permanently true for reasons unrelated to DV-D17, **and would have survived a complete revert of the fix.** ⇒ **DV-D17 stays ENACTED · DOM-PROVEN (108/108 + 27/27, three neutered controls) · RENDER-OWED.** ⚠ **Do NOT mark it render-verified on a green run of the probe as written.**
- **⚠ A QUESTION THAT IS DAVE'S, LOGGED NOT CHASED:** if the treatment has never painted, **the screenshot behind DV-D17 showed something** — either a context not yet probed, or the treatment worked once and regressed silently. Worth knowing which.
- **★ WHAT I GOT WRONG, AND IT IS THE TRANSFERABLE PART: THE FIRST RUN PRINTED `24 checks · 0 failures` AND WAS A FALSE GREEN.** The probe carried a positive control *precisely* to stop a vacuous pass — the solo row's paint must differ from baseline or the probe is blind. **It compared computed strings.** Solo bg serialises `oklab(0 0 0 / 0)`, baseline `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)` — **textually different, visually identical (both fully transparent)** — so the control "saw a difference" and passed. **Caught BY EYE reading the JSON, not by the check.** ⇒ **Compare computed colours AS COLOURS (parse r/g/b/a), never as strings; a control that can pass on a serialisation difference is not a control.** ⚠ This happened *inside the probe written to honour* [[stale-reading-failure-mode]]'s sibling rule *"assume your probe is wrong in the direction that reads as green"* — **the rule was quoted in the file's own docstring and still did not prevent the failure it names**, because the control was checked for existence, not for sensitivity. Same shape as #7's stale-suite finding, and as ds-018/ds-019 themselves: **the instrument was present, correct-looking, and not measuring what it claimed.**
- **✅ HARNESS RE-PROVEN FROM COLD, runbook verbatim, no new steps** — pip→mount · TLS env · `chromium-headless-shell` (non-zero exit after a successful download = expected host-validation) · 11 libs via `apt-get download` · two-alias fontconfig · render. **NEW POTHOLE BANKED:** `PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH` on the outputs mount ends the install with **`EPERM: operation not permitted, rmdir '__dirlock'`** — **same species as the host-validation exit: a failure message following a success. Check the cache, proceed.**
- **Evidence:** `outputs/_render-env/probe.py` + `diag.py` + `probe-result.json` · 2026-07-27 · four contexts, **font assert passed in all four** · declaration census `awk`/`grep -c` over `canon/canon.css` + `snippets/Chart-*.reference.html` · 2026-07-27 · defects `knowledge/_DS-IMPROVEMENTS.md` **ds-018 § CONFIRMED block** + **ds-019 NEW** · dossier `_DECISION-HISTORY/2026-07-27-the-treatment-that-never-painted.md`.
- **⬛ NOTHING BUILT — Dave chose LOG-AND-STOP at the fork.** Priced at the finding: fill ~48% + naming the overriding rule ~8% ⇒ **~61% RED**, over the band and into the ring-fenced reserve; fixing was unbounded from there, **and `dv-legend.js` has 54 bytes free with the group at 90%**, so anything touching behaviour hits the ADR-0015 gate. **The throttle fired on an unplanned finding exactly as ruled — stop, re-price, fork to Dave rather than decide from inside the sunk cost.** Per the perishable-allowance logic: **behind pace, more windows beat longer ones.**
- **⬛ STILL OPEN, untouched:** ds-019's overriding rule (the single next step, cheap + bounded) · DV-D17's render-proof (owed, and now known to need ds-019 first) · both ds-018 gates · ds-016 · the `CTRL` sweep (ruled YES, not started) · call (4) · ds-017's remedy · ds-012 · DV-D16/D18 · the 15-item ruling batch · the per-member behaviour opt-in schema question.

## ⏱ PRIOR DELTA — 2026-07-27 (Mon **afternoon #7**, OPUS solo self-conducting, effort MAX — ★ **DV-D17 ENACTED — the first BUILD window after three record-only ones; DOM-proven, render OWED by Dave's ruling** · ★ **SIX GREEN CHECKS WERE ASSERTING THE SUPERSEDED RULING** · ★ **the donut's "sequence" is ONE timeline, so DV-D16 re-prices DOWN** · ★ **legend migration is COMPLETE and nothing said so** · build **60/60 GREEN**) — "The suite was an inscription of the old ruling, and only running it said so."

- **★ DV-D17 ENACTED — `canon/dv-legend.js`, four lines.** A blank swatch checked while isolated now sets `st.isolated = null; st.focus = null` and leaves isolate mode, so no row keeps `.is-solo` while several series show. Injected into all **5** registered consumers by `gen_component_partials.py`. **All three named bites covered**, each with its own failing control. ⚠ **RENDER-VERIFY IN THE LICENSED CUT IS OWED, NOT DONE** — jsdom proves the state machine, not that `.is-solo` stops painting, and **ds-018 is a live counter-example on this same component.** Pair them in one Green window: same page, same harness, same two widths, **one spin-up instead of two.**
- **★ THE FINDING — A CONFORMANCE SUITE GOES STALE EXACTLY LIKE PROSE DOES.** Baseline **100/100** + **27/27**; after the fix **85/100** + **23/27**. The red was not a regression — **six checks encoded the ADDITIVE FOCUS SET, the half of DV-D11 that DV-D17 supersedes** (members 20/21, donut 12/13/14/20). Nothing in the repo connected *"DV-D17 is ruled"* to *"six assertions now state the opposite"*; **only running the suite surfaced it.** Sibling of [[assertion-propagation-gap]], in a surface nobody had counted: **the verification tooling itself.** All six **REWRITTEN, NOT DELETED** — old wording kept verbatim beside each, so a reversal can never read as agent drift.
- **★ BITE-THE-BITE ×3, without ever mutating canon.** Both suites gained a **`DVLEGEND` env override** (the idiom they already use for `JSDOM`), so neutered copies are pointed at from outside. full revert → **99/108 + 23/27** · release-to-**all-on** → **105/108** · release-**silently** → **104/108 + 26/27** · control → **108/108 + 27/27**. ⚠ **PUBLISHED LIMIT: the donut suite CANNOT catch the all-on regression** (27/27 under it) — its scenario starts all-visible, where `visible[]` and all-on are indistinguishable. **Only the members suite dims a spare BEFORE isolating.** The two suites are not interchangeable proofs of bite (i).
- **★ STEP 0 ANSWERED FROM THE REPO, AND IT IS A FINDING.** `sweepDonut()` (`Chart-donut.reference.html:889–945`) runs **ONE timeline** — one `dur=850`, one `t0`, one rAF loop, **one sweeping angle**. Segments only *appear* to hand off because one angle crosses them in order; the velocity envelope (accelerate through segment 1's arc → cruise → decelerate through segment N's) **is already Dave's easing rule, as one continuous curve.** `prefers-reduced-motion` baked at `:901–906`. ⇒ **"same as the pie" is TRUE OF THE EASING, FALSE OF THE APPEARANCE under wording ②** — reuse the architecture, envelope and reduced-motion answer; **do not cite the donut as a visual precedent for ②.**
- **★ DV-D16 RE-PRICED DOWN ~30% → ~19%, which is the direction nobody double-checks.** Measured at `Chart-bar.reference.html:121–128`: stacked segments **already** run `scaleY(0)→1` from `transform-origin:bottom`, **all at once**, one `--grow:760ms`, CSS-only. **Concurrency exists.** Two deltas remain: **(a)** upper segments don't FLOAT (each grows from a fixed anchor ⇒ the stack gaps mid-animation) · **(b)** one shared cubic-bezier, no per-segment curves. Both pure-CSS (cumulative below-height is static per chart ⇒ a per-rect custom property), so **no JS enters physics** — B-D7 / DEF-003 hold. ⚠ **Re-derive before building; a cheap-looking job is what the throttle exists to doubt.**
- **★ CORRECTED IN-WINDOW — I READ A GATE'S ADVICE TEXT AS LIVE STATE, and caught it at ritual step 3.** `_check_legend_migration.py` **does** exit 0 (WAVE COMPLETE), and GM/`_LIVE-STATE` **were** stale — they said *"combo + line remain"* after commit **`ba336dc`** had already migrated them. **That much stands.** But the gate prints its *"Now: delete the TRANSITIONAL block…"* list **UNCONDITIONALLY** (`_check_legend_migration.py:87–89`), and **`ba336dc` had already done it**: `dv-behaviour.js:146` is a **tombstone comment** where the block used to be (15,771 → **13,004 B**), and `class="dv-legrow` stays in the members' `extraContracts` **deliberately** — promoting it to the universal contract **fails the build**, because sparkline and scatter are in the dataviz GROUP but carry no legend. ⇒ **THERE IS NO CLEANUP LEFT AND NO RELIEF VALVE.** A memory file held the correct state the whole time and I hadn't read it yet. **Sibling of [[gate-narrows-its-own-rule]]: a gate said one true thing (exit 0) beside one stale thing (its todo list), and I took both as current.**
- **⚠ SO THE CEILING IS WORSE THAN THE FIRST WRITE-UP SAID, and that is the real finding.** `dv-legend.js` = **16330 / 16384 bytes, 54 to spare**; dataviz page budget **29334 / 32768 = 90%** (was 88% before this session's comments). **Nothing cheap buys space back.** The known real fix is already on the board and is **Dave's call, not an enactment**: **per-member behaviour opt-in in the registry** (a schema change — the same item `Chart-sparkline`'s inert 15.6KB payload has been waiting on since 07-26, §C·4). **The next behaviour change to this group does not fit until that lands.**
- **⚠ ONE ENACTMENT CALL IS MINE, NOT DAVE'S, AND IS UNRULED.** Release also sets `st.visible[id] = true` so the clicked series is showing. The literal reading restores `visible[]` **alone**; both satisfy bite (i), and they differ only when a series dimmed *before* isolating is then the one clicked — the literal reading leaves it dimmed, so the click that ended the mode does nothing to what was clicked. **One line either way, Dave's to reverse.**
- **⚠ A DV-D13 CONSEQUENCE THE RULING DID NOT NAME — needs Dave's eye.** Isolate Housing (`950/41%`) then check a second series: that click now **releases**, so the donut's centre returns to `2320/100%` instead of growing to `1250/54%`. **DV-D13 is intact** — the centre still follows the SELECTION; the selection is simply everything again.
- **Evidence:** build `python3 knowledge/_build_all.py` **60/60 GREEN exit 0** · 2026-07-27 · `node knowledge/_verify_dv_legend_members.js` **108/108** · 2026-07-27 · `node knowledge/_verify_dv_legend.js` **27/27** · 2026-07-27 · bite matrix via `DVLEGEND=<neutered> node …` (4 rows above) · 2026-07-27 · migration `python3 knowledge/_check_legend_migration.py` **exit 0** · 2026-07-27 · sizes `knowledge/_BEHAVIOUR-GATE.md` (16330 / 16384; group 29334 / 32768) · 2026-07-27 · ledger `_proforma/_DATAVIZ-DECISIONS.md` § Batch 10 **DV-D17 ENACTED block** + **DV-D16 (1) ANSWERED** · dossier `_DECISION-HISTORY/2026-07-27-the-suite-that-asserted-the-old-ruling.md`.
- **⬛ NOT DONE, by Dave's ruling ("wrap and flush") — the throttle's second real use, and its FIRST on a job mid-flight:** the render-verify. Priced at the fork: fill ~55% + render ~10% + wrap ~5% ⇒ **~70% RED**; flushing lands ~60%. **He chose flush.** ⚠ **The overrun is recorded per the throttle's own instruction:** DV-D17 was priced at 15% and ran nearer 20 — **entirely on the byte-cap detour, which was self-inflicted, not a discovery.**

## ⏱ PRIOR DELTA — 2026-07-27 (Mon **afternoon #6**, OPUS solo self-conducting, effort MAX — ★ **DAVE'S THREE CHART FLAGS CAPTURED AND RULED — DV-D16/17/18 + ds-018; NOTHING ENACTED** · ★ **DV-D16a REVERSED IN-WINDOW: the option-select read-back offered three shapes and the right answer was in none of them** · build **60/60 GREEN**; 🟡 AMBER at ritual, flushed by Dave's choice) — "He picked an option, then twenty minutes later described what he actually meant, and it rejected the option he'd picked."

- **★ THREE FLAGS IN, WRITTEN DOWN BEFORE ANYTHING WAS DISCUSSED.** Dave: *"I want to make changes to the charts too, I've noticed a couple of missed decisions, please note this."* Per **ds-017** (which cost the start of session #5), the placeholder went into `_DATAVIZ-DECISIONS.md` § Open/pending **at the moment of the ask**, marked `OBSERVED-BY-DAVE, contents UNSTATED` + *"do not guess which decisions he means"* — then filled in as **§ Batch 10** when he supplied them. **Nothing lived only in the chat at any point.**
- **★ DV-D16 — stacked animation. ⚠⚠ RULED, THEN REVERSED IN THE SAME WINDOW; BOTH WORDINGS KEPT.** ① *"segment by segment"* (serial hand-off) — **selected from a read-back, SUPERSEDED, do not build.** ② **IN FORCE: concurrent growth on ONE shared timeline** — Dave: *"they all grow at the same time, so they are floating and growing, rather than growing and 'handing off' to the next."* Upper segments **float** upward as the ones below grow; **per-segment easing curves, not per-segment timelines**: bottom `ease-in` · top `ease-out` · middles `linear` (the easing rule from the original ask is unchanged and is the durable part). Scope = **EVERY stacked surface**; `prefers-reduced-motion` **ships with the first enactment** (Dave: *"fine"*) — ⚠ *reduced ≠ shortened*.
- **★ THE METHOD FINDING, and it is mine not Dave's: A READ-BACK CAN ONLY OFFER ANSWERS THE ASKER THOUGHT OF.** Three tidy mutually-exclusive options *read* as a complete space and were not one; **a selection from an incomplete option set is indistinguishable from a ruling.** The instrument still earned its place — it produced the correction — but **it manufactures confidence in proportion to how well-formed the options look.** ⇒ **Standing mitigation, inscribed in the ledger: when reading back a MOTION or FEEL decision, describe the resulting SENSATION, not the mechanism.** *"The top blocks float as the bottom grows"* would have been recognised on sight; *"segment 2 starts when segment 1 lands"* was not. Sibling of [[feedback-clarify-reflect-back]] — **the reflect-back happened, correctly, and still under-determined the answer.**
- **★ DV-D18 — cap stacked segments at 6** (Dave, aligning with the donut's `dv-pie-009`), **+ ★★ FLOATED: bucketed "Other" segments must be EXPANDABLE** (*"through some mechanism we'll explore later"*, `_FUTURE-STATE.md`, unscoped by instruction). ⚠ **The two are load-bearing together — a cap with no route to the detail is data loss dressed as legibility**, and that is already the donut's live state. ⚠ **JUSTIFICATION SHIFT RECORDED, not quietly re-argued:** the cap answered a *duration* problem under serial motion; **concurrent motion dissolved that problem** (one timeline ⇒ N is free), so the cap now rests on **legibility alone**. The open duration ruling closed by ceasing to exist.
- **★ DV-D17 — RELEASE ISOLATION ENTIRELY on the second check-on.** Cause read from source, not inferred: `dv-legend.js:114/119` derive `.is-solo` from `st.isolated`, which `:129` keeps pinned while `st.focus` grows ⇒ the origin row keeps an ink border + 6% ink fill while three series show (**the screenshot**). Accepted cost, stated at ruling time: **no 2-of-5 comparison by isolate-then-add.** ⚠ **Three enactment bites named in the ledger:** restore to `visible[]` not all-on · **Reset must not self-disable while still filtered** (`:122` — *same expression ds-018 lives in, do not conflate*) · `dv-sr` must announce release on the **add** path (`:140` fires only on re-click).
- **★ ds-018 LOGGED — Reset's DISABLED state renders as its HOVER state** (Dave by eye). CSS is **correct as authored** (`:hover` already `:not(:disabled)`) ⇒ **two competing causes, and the record refuses to choose between them by reading CSS:** `--border-disabled` set to an ink-ish value (token-value bug) **vs** failing to resolve ⇒ invalid-at-computed-value-time ⇒ `currentColor` = ink (**which would be instance FIVE** of ds-010 · ds-013 · black-keys · ds-016). ⚠ **Separate them by `getComputedStyle`, snippet AND showroom, two widths. - **★ THE HEADLINE, and it is Dave's: INSTRUMENT FIT IS A THIRD AXIS.** Angle (1) of the FLOATED idea (*compare what a rule SAYS against what its gate DEMANDS*) **would NOT have caught `aid-009`.** The rule names *"a minimum 44×44px target area"*; the gate calls its check *"target size"* — **the vocabulary matches; the narrowing is in the INSTRUMENT.** A static regex observes a *declared box*; the rule is about a *target*. They stop tracking each other the moment the property is expressed through a mechanism (expander · token · transform) — and **the gate goes QUIET, not RED.** ⇒ **Sits ON TOP of ADR-0016, not inside it:** PROVEN/CLAIMED/UNPROVEN ask *"is there a check and can it fail?"*; this asks *"is it looking at the right thing?"* — **a check can be PROVEN and still measure a proxy that doesn't track its rule.** dv-004 was the *narrowing* case; `aid-009` is the *instrument* case, and it is larger.
- **★ ds-015 — ADOPTING THE CORRECT MECHANISM IS WHAT REMOVES A COMPONENT FROM THE CHECK.** `_validate_a11y.py` does not mis-measure the `::before` expander; it **`continue`s**, deferring to a "render axis" that **does not exist** (the hit-area gate is still PENDING DAVE SIGN-OFF). **MEASURED: 67 snippets · 1,869 selectors skipped by the `CTRL` vocabulary · 14 eligible · 7 exempted · 7 actually measured.** Verdict **0 failures, exit 0**; 64 of 67 snippets use `::before`. **The diamond proves it three times** (`.dv-leg-sw.sw-diamond`, 8×8 + `rotate(45deg)`): out of `CTRL` scope · expander is `min-width:var(--hit,44px)` and the regex reads literal `(\d+)px` · `::before` → exempt. ⚠ And its real defect is a **transform** consequence — **no static box measurement can see that in principle**; `elementFromPoint` caught it by hand in the legend wave.
- **★ DAVE'S SECOND REFRAME — the propagation defect, and the strongest angle yet.** *"we are relying too much on my memory here, the hit mechanism should have triggered something that cascaded this elsewhere."* Adoption is a LOCAL CSS decision with a GLOBAL governance consequence and **nothing carried it** — no registry entry, no re-check, no flag. Sibling of the assertion-propagation gap, but worse: **the gate never fires at all, because the adoption IS the exemption.** ⇒ **The trigger should be ADOPTION-TIME, not sweep-time.** Cheapest cut: make claiming the exemption require naming the rule it exempts from, and let the register harvest it — **an exemption that must declare itself is one you can count.**

True totals **28 · 38 · 54**; agent sees **17–22%** of the material, and **BLOCKING rules truncate too** (5 of 16). (2) `enforcement_for_rule()` decides gated-ness by **keyword overlap between rule text and gate text/glob** — it never opens the gate. **54 BLOCKING rules · consult claims a gate for 25 · 10 of those are named in no `.py` file at all.** ⚠ Stated then and now: that proves **unverified**, not **unenforced**. In fairness the docstring is candid ("possibly gated by", "answered per-query") — **it is a good hint; the defect appears only when Dave's proposal promotes the hint to an authority.**
- **★ PRE-FLIGHT NOW HAS THREE TERMS (Dave: *"remember that it self consumes tockens too"* + *"encode a pre-flight mechanism rather than loosing it in this chat"*).** The rule was already inscribed, so it was NOT re-litigated — what was missing is the **meta-cost**. ⇒ `_RUNBOOK-context-gauge.md`: **"A pre-flight estimate that does not include the wrap is not a pre-flight estimate" — `fill + job + WRAP (~5%) = projected band`, always three terms.** Consequences: **reserve the wrap BEFORE starting the job** (at Amber the question is never *"can I fit this job?"* but *"can I fit this job AND the ritual?"*) · instruments obey their own bands — **except reading the band table.** Evidence: last session priced its render job right (53%, held) then ran **the ritual unpriced**, 58→63, band corrected at close. **Applied to itself same window: the instrument-tagging build was CUT, not started.**

Plus the runbook clause above. **Nothing else built — his instruction was explore, not build.**

## ⏱ PRIOR DELTA — 2026-07-27 (Mon **later morning #2**, OPUS solo self-conducting, effort MAX — ★ **ds-014 CALLS (a)+(b) RULED BY DAVE, ENACTED AND PROVEN BY RENDER** · ★ **the gate had NARROWED ITS OWN RULE — dv-004's text is mechanism-neutral, its gate demanded a stroke** · **`dv-vocab` NEW BLOCKING: unknown chart types can no longer skip silently** · build **58/58 GREEN**; register **PROVEN 3→4, UNPROVEN 53→52**; 🟡 AMBER ~58% wrap) — "Dave declined my recommendation and asked why I'd made it. Checking cost one grep and he was right — the donut's stroke mechanism doesn't transfer to a plot with gridlines behind it. Chasing *why* I'd recommended it found the real defect: the gate had quietly narrowed a mechanism-neutral rule into one mechanism, so it wasn't just failing to catch the error, it was the source of it."

- **★ DV-D14 — dv-004 is satisfied by GEOMETRY on gridded plots (Dave's ruling, against my recommendation).** I proposed the donut's 2px `stroke="var(--page)"`. Dave: *"I prefer the geometry the border will obscure gridlines, may I know why you recommend borders?"* **He was right and the check took one grep: `cb5` carries 5 full-width `.dv-grid` lines behind the columns; the donut carries none.** An SVG stroke straddles its path, so 2px puts 1px OUTSIDE each rect — painting over every gridline down both sides of all 4 columns. ⇒ **A surface-coloured stroke only simulates separation when the thing behind it IS the surface.** Enacted **variant A, both ends pinned**: baseline `y=230` and each stack top stay TRUE, the 4px comes out of segment heights. **Accepted cost, stated at ruling time: segments understate 2.0–2.6%, worst on the shortest column.**
- **★ THE FINDING THAT OUTRANKS THE CHART — the gate had narrowed the rule.** dv-004's text is **mechanism-NEUTRAL** (*"minimum 2px separation between colour blocks"*); `_validate_dataviz.py` enforced *"must carry a surface-coloured stroke >=2px"*. Both directions bite: a chart satisfying dv-004 by real geometry **would have FAILED**, and **an agent reading the gate to learn what compliance looks like gets the wrong answer** — which is exactly what happened to me. Dave supplied the governing fact from the KG (*"the gap is only 2px minimum, this is in the dataviz specifications in the KG"*) and then named the class himself → **held as FLOATED in `_FUTURE-STATE.md`** (his exploration, do not build ahead of it). ⚠ Caution recorded there: the consult prints `rulings (5/5 shown, --all for more)` — **it TRUNCATES**, so a forcing function built on it would be a CLAIMED gate with extra steps.
- **★ DV-D15 — `data/text/on-series` MINTED (Dave's promotion).** The keys had declared `var(--page)`: white today only because of where the neutral ramp sits — **a coincidence, not an intent**. New role → `color/grey/white`, **pinned in BOTH modes**, modelled on `rag/text/on-dark`; **deliberately NO alpha channel** (DV-D07 computes contrast from the composite, so an alpha slot is a route to passing on the hex and failing on screen). **type26-013 does NOT collide** — checked, not assumed: *"black/dark-grey on light · white/light-grey on dark"* covers it; the white-only clause is specific to RED grounds.
- **★ THE VOCABULARY HAD FORKED — fixed structurally, not by enumeration.** The corpus carries **both `stacked` and `stacked-column`, both `grouped` and `grouped-column`**, plus `scatter`. Adding three strings would have guaranteed a repeat ⇒ **`DTYPE_CANON` normalises once at read time** + **`dv-vocab` (NEW, BLOCKING) fails the build on any dtype the gate has never heard of**, naming the rules that would have skipped it. Scope-blindness audit: 3 blind values → **"none detected"**. **The dataviz selftest is now WIRED into the build** — it existed and ran only by hand, which is precisely why nothing ever proved dv-004 could fail. 9 new bites, incl. one reproducing the exact ds-014 figure.
- **⚠ A THIRD SILENT-FALLBACK, and it happened AFTER the build went green.** Token minted, generated into `canon.css`, build 58/58 — **and the keys still rendered BLACK at 3.99:1.** The snippet carries a LOCAL MIRROR of the token list for standalone preview and didn't declare the new var; **`fill:var(--undefined)` falls back to the SVG initial value, black, in silence.** Third instance of one class, three different mechanisms: ds-010 (author CSS beat `fill=`) · ds-013 (404 stylesheet) · this. **Through-line: a lookup that misses and reports nothing — and in all three the markup is CORRECT, so no static gate reaches it.**
- **★ PROVEN BY RENDER — `knowledge/_verify_dv_stacked_enactment.py` (NEW, the ADR-0016 P2 proof).** Licensed cut, **snippet AND showroom pane, 1180 AND 760, all four agreeing**: separation **2.00px** on all 8 boundaries; keys white at **5.26 / 5.04 / 4.61:1** vs AA 4.5. ⚠ **The prior handoff predicted "≈5:1"; MEASURED worst case is 4.61:1** (series-3, margin **0.11**) — recorded as measured. **Series-3 cannot be lightened without breaking AA.**
- **⚠ THE PROBE COMMITTED THE ERROR IT WAS WRITTEN TO DETECT — third session running.** First run reported *"no stacked-column figure"* for the showroom; the honest reading was not "the showroom is broken" but **"I queried the top document and the panes are `srcdoc` iframes"**. Last session's probe used `querySelector('svg')` and got the toolbar copy icon. **Standing lesson, earned three times: assume your probe is wrong in the direction that reads as green.**
- **⬛ (d) donut cluster alignment — PARKED on Dave's ruling.** Logged in `_DS-IMPROVEMENTS.md`, deliberately NOT fixed; rule it in a session where he can see it live.
- **Evidence:** build `_build_all.py` **58/58 GREEN exit 0** · 2026-07-27 · gate selftest **22/22** incl. 9 new · 2026-07-27 · render proof `_verify_dv_stacked_enactment.py` **ALL ASSERTIONS PASS**, 4 contexts · 2026-07-27 · register `knowledge/_ENACTMENT-REGISTER.md` PROVEN 4 / CLAIMED 20 / UNPROVEN 52 of 76 · 2026-07-27 · ledger DV-D14 + DV-D15 · dossier `_DECISION-HISTORY/2026-07-27-the-gate-that-narrowed-its-own-rule.md`.
- **🔴 Gauge at ritual close: RED ~63% (ESTIMATE ±15%) — CORRECTED.** Banner authored at a true AMBER ~58%; the ritual cost ~5% more, crossing the Red≥60 line. Read off the band table, not recalled. **AMBER ~58%** — wrapped deliberately at Dave's "wrap up" rather than starting the remaining 52 P2 proofs hot. **Pre-flight was stated before the render job, per the new rule, and held.**
