## ⏱ PRIOR DELTA — 2026-07-27 (Mon **later** morning, OPUS solo self-conducting, effort MAX — ★ **ADR-0016 BUILT: the ENACTMENT REGISTER** — *3 of 76 rulings (4%) are PROVEN* — **+ ds-014 DISCHARGED by render: 2 lost decisions, 2 artefacts** — build **57/57 GREEN**, register wired advisory as step 56; 🔴 RED ~92% wrap) — "Dave said 'as you advise', so: discriminator first, then the build he ruled. The discriminator settled all four of his flags in one pass. Then the register generalised the finding and put a number on the debt he had been feeling: **4%.**"

- **★ ds-014 SETTLED — measured, not argued.** Every flag rendered in the licensed cut at 1180 **and** 760, **snippet beside showroom pane** — the one pass that separates a lost decision from a ds-013 artefact. **Two are genuinely lost, two were the type outage:**
  - **#2 stacked SEGMENT SPACING — LOST.** Gap **0.0–0.1px** across all 4 columns × 3 boundaries, `stroke:none`. **dv-004 is BLOCKING and requires ≥2px.**
  - **#3 stacked ALPHA-KEY CONTRAST — LOST.** Keys render **`#1A1A1A` (`--ink`)**, not the `var(--page)` their own markup declares: `text.dv-barkey{fill:var(--ink)}` overrides the SVG presentation attribute. **3.31 / 3.46 / 3.78:1** at 12px/700 against AA's 4.5:1 floor. White measures ≈5:1 and passes.
  - **#1 label scale · #4 donut centring — ARTEFACTS.** Donut centre value **dx +0.00 / dy −2.00** (optical), ring offset **0.00** in canvas, identical snippet vs showroom at both widths. ds-013 had been the whole story.
- **★ WHY #2 SHIPPED GREEN, AND IT IS BIGGER THAN ONE CHART.** `_validate_dataviz.py` guards dv-004 with `if dtype in ("donut","pie","stacked")`; the figure declares **`stacked-column`**. **The gate never looked.** ⚠ **PROVEN BY BITE, in a scratch copy:** adding that one string to the tuple makes the gate fail with `✗ dv-004: stacked-column segment lacks a >=2px surface-coloured separating stroke.` The corpus carries **three** such blind values — `stacked-column`, `grouped-column`, `scatter` — appearing **zero** times in the gate ⇒ **dv-004, dv-bar-009 and dv-line-011 are all inert on those chart types.**
- **★ ADR-0016 + `_ENACTMENT-REGISTER.md` — P1 SHIPPED, P3 WIRED ADVISORY.** `_build_enactment_register.py` harvests every ruling from the four ledgers + all ADRs and asks the question no other step asks: *is this ruling LIVE in the artefact Dave looks at?* **PROVEN 3 · CLAIMED 20 · UNPROVEN 53 · NOT-GATEABLE 0 of 76.** The four-verdict scheme is the contribution: **CLAIMED** = a check names it but nothing proves the check can fail — **ds-013 lived there for weeks**, reporting a cheerful "0 deviations" while blind. Advisory on purpose: *a gate that fails 53 rows on day one gets switched off, and a switched-off gate is how we got here.*
- **⬛ FOUR CALLS ARE DAVE'S** (derivation governance — measured, never fixed): **(a)** dv-004 on stacked columns = 2px stroke or geometry gap? **(b)** alpha keys back to white per the D-Q2 ledger line, or re-rule to ink and accept 3.3:1? **(c)** widening the gate's vocabulary is mechanical but turns (a) into a build failure, so it lands *with* (a). **(d)** NEW + un-ruled: `.dv-donut-row` is `flex-start`, so the ring+legend cluster pins left and whitespace grows with viewport (**−114px at 600 → −534px at 1440**). No ruling covers donut cluster alignment.
- **⚠ ONE SELF-INFLICTED CORRECTION, inscribed not buried.** ADR-0016's first draft said *75 rulings / 52 UNPROVEN* — written before the generator ran. The register harvests ADRs, so **ADR-0016 counts itself**: the measured figures are **76 / 53**. Corrected in place; same class as Correction 2 of 2026-07-26. **The probe made the same mistake and was caught the same way:** its first donut pass used `querySelector('svg')`, which returns the **toolbar copy icon**, not the chart canvas — it reported a 16px-wide "chart". Fixed with an explicit `svg.dv-svg` + an icon guard.
- **🔴 RED ~92% (Dave's calibration; I had said 85%, and called that Amber) — and the GAUGE FAILED TWICE (Dave, at wrap). This is a finding, not a footnote.** ⚠ **(1) I labelled 85% "Amber".** Bands are **Green<45 / Amber 45–60 / Red≥60**; 85 is deep Red. The mislabel propagated into `GOOD-MORNING`, here, and Dave's summary — *a false reading of the instrument built to catch false readings.* **(2) Dave's, and the more useful one: the gauge was only consulted at WRAP.** An estimate produced after the work is spent cannot change anything. ⇒ Ruled into `_RUNBOOK-context-gauge.md`: **PRE-FLIGHT estimate before committing to a big job** + **read the band table, never recall it**. ⇒ **P2 opens on a fresh window, and this banner's prose gets re-verified before anyone builds on it.**

## ⏱ ARCHIVED DELTA — 2026-07-27 (Mon morning, OPUS solo self-conducting, effort MAX — ★ **LEGEND WAVE CLOSED** (combo + line migrated, 100/100, transitional block deleted, page budget 88%) **+ ds-013 FIXED + GATED: `srcdoc` had killed `type.css` in ALL 49 showroom panes**; build 56/56 GREEN; commit `ba336dc`; 🔴 RED ~80% wrap) — "Dave opened with a bug report rather than a lane — the chart legend labels were too big, all except Reset. He was right, and the cause was three tiers below the charts: the showroom's srcdoc panes had never been able to load type.css at all. Fixed and gated, then the two remaining lanes landed and the transition closed."

- **★ ds-013 — LIBRARY-WIDE TYPE OUTAGE IN THE SHOWROOM, found by DAVE'S EYE.** `gen_showroom.py` delivers each snippet to its pane iframe via **`srcdoc`**, and a srcdoc document inherits the **parent's** base URL — so `<link href="../canon/type.css">`, correct from `knowledge/snippets/`, re-resolved against `showroom/` to a non-existent path. **type.css 404'd in all 49 panes that link it**; every `.t-cm-*` composite and selector binding was inert. Measured (computed styles, licensed cut): legend label **16px/400 → 12px/500**, key **→ 12px/700**. **Reset was correct only because its snippet CSS hard-codes `font-size:12px`** — the exact asymmetry Dave reported. **Longstanding, OBSERVED not inferred:** the pre-migration snippet renders **13.333px** (button UA default) under the same condition. Full record: `knowledge/_DS-IMPROVEMENTS.md` ds-013.
- **★ FIXED + GATED (`gen_showroom.py`).** `rebase_payload_urls()` re-points payload URLs; **a rebased URL whose target does not exist FAILS THE BUILD** — the condition is gated, not the instance. 6-bite `--selftest` wired as build step 56. ⚠ Anti-false-fix pinned by bite 2: an injected `<base href>` would re-base fragment URLs and **break every icon sprite in the library**. The selftest caught a genuine defect in the fix itself (dropped `?query`/`#fragment` suffixes) before it shipped.
- **★ LANES ②③ — THE WAVE IS COMPLETE.** Chart-combo (`cc1`, 2 series) + Chart-line (`cl2`, 3 series) on DV-D11. **Combo keeps ONE shape modifier** (circle, for its line series) — two mark types on one plot make shape a real non-colour channel, where bar's were dropped for being all rects. **Line earns the full circle/square/diamond set.** ⚠ **The divvy did not name this:** the diamond's `rotate(45deg)` also rotates its 44px hit-area `::before`, standing the target on its corner — **counter-rotated**, proved with `elementFromPoint` probes at 1180 and 760.
- **★ THE VERIFY SUITE WAS LYING BY CONSTRUCTION.** `_verify_dv_legend_members.js` had baked in bar's **three** series and the **literal string "Current"**; it crashed on a 2-series member and would have passed any member whose series happened to share the name. Generalised to per-N invariants with names read off the markup. **54 → 100 checks, bar's 54 unchanged.** *(Standing lesson: a suite that hardcodes one member's data cannot verify the next one — and it fails in the direction that reads as green.)*
- **★ TRANSITION CLOSED** (`_check_legend_migration.py` exit 0): transitional block deleted from `dv-behaviour.js` (**15,771 → 13,004 B**), dead `.dv-legend*`/`.dv-legbtn*`/`.dv-quiet` CSS deleted from all four members. **Page budget 31,490 → 28,723 B (88%).** ⚠ **The prior handoff predicted 85% / 27,768 B — 88% is the MEASURED figure.** Recorded as measured, per that handoff's own Correction 2.
- **★ A PROMOTION TRIED, MEASURED AND REVERSED — inscribed as both beats.** Promoting `class="dv-legrow` to dv-legend's universal contract (the old registry note's instruction) **failed the build, correctly**: Chart-sparkline and Chart-scatter belong to the dataviz behaviour **GROUP** but carry no legend. **The group is broader than the capability** ⇒ universal contract stays EMPTY — now permanently, and for a better reason than during the wave. Real fix = the already-open per-member behaviour **opt-in** (schema change, Dave's).
- **⬛ OWED → NEXT SESSION, and it is the whole point of it: the 49 changed panes have not been looked at.** Registered in `_REVIEW-SIGNOFF.md`. Dave chose "lanes now, sweep after"; the lanes consumed the window. **Build the sweep as a numeric assertion** (see `GOOD-MORNING` §DO-FIRST) — an eyeball pass authored at this gauge is the failure mode, not the mitigation.
- **Build/verify:** `_build_all.py` **56/56 GREEN** (55 + the new selftest step) · exemplar **27/27** · members **100/100** · migration checker **exit 0** · render-verified at **1180 and 760** in the licensed cut (label sizes · swatch shapes · the diamond's counter-rotated hit area · mark ghosting · live-region announcements). Commit **`ba336dc`** — ⚠ UNPUSHED, Dave pushes via Desktop.
- **🔴 Gauge at authoring: RED ~80% (in-head tally, ESTIMATE ±15%).** ⇒ **RE-VERIFY BEFORE BUILDING — including the PROSE.** Every one of Saturday's three errors was in prose a gate cannot see, and this was written hotter.

Wrapped at Amber on Dave's call rather than author combo and line under the same heat that produced them."

- **★ RE-VERIFY OF THE 🔴 RED HANDOFF — gates GREEN, record WRONG in three places.** `_build_all.py` **55/55** and `_verify_dv_legend.js` **27/27** both held, cold. The failures were all on the surface no gate covers. **⇒ Standing lesson: a Red re-verify must include the assertions a gate cannot see** — prose instructions and quoted numbers are exactly where late-session error concentrates. WHY/HOW: `_DECISION-HISTORY/2026-07-26-legend-wave-lane-1-and-three-record-corrections.md`.
- **★ CORRECTION 1 — the end condition could never fire.** `grep -l data-series-toggle knowledge/snippets/Chart-*.reference.html` matched **all five** snippets including the migrated donut: the transitional block's own source carries the bare string and is injected into every member. Replaced by **`knowledge/_check_legend_migration.py`** (strips the AUTO-BEHAVIOUR regions, reports per member, exit 0 = authorised to delete). ⚠ **My own first framing was too strong and is corrected in the record:** grepping `data-series-toggle="` *does* discriminate today — the objection is that it does so on punctuation luck and fails in the direction that authorises a premature deletion. `--verbose` prints both columns.
- **★ CORRECTION 2 — the byte figures were PREDICTIONS labelled as CURRENT.** Actual at session start: dv-behaviour **15,618 B** + dv-legend **15,719 B**, page **31,337 B (96%)** — not 12,682 / 15,650 / 95%. The 12,682 is within ~600 B of the *post-deletion* size (15,618 − 3,569 transitional block = 12,049). **Post-deletion really lands at ~27,768 B (85%), not 28,332 B (86%).**
- **★ CORRECTION 3 — the COPY-SOURCE was documenting a dead model.** `Chart-donut.reference.html` header §3 still described `data-series-toggle` buttons / shift-click isolate / "centre keeps the FULL total" as live, and its migration comment claimed the dead `.dv-legend*` rules "still serve Chart-bar/combo/line" — they cannot, snippet CSS is hoisted into canon.css NAMESPACED per component. Both fixed **before** three lanes copy from it.
- **★ CHART-BAR MIGRATED — wave member 2, verified 54/54.** Both legends (cb4 grouped · cb5 stacked) on the dual-gesture markup + `.dv-leg*` CSS + ghost/faded/peek ladder + `#cb4-live`/`#cb5-live` + canon-disabled Reset; `extraContract` swapped. **New suite `knowledge/_verify_dv_legend_members.js` (54/54)** — the exemplar's script is donut-specific, this one asserts the per-member invariants **plus 8 cross-talk checks for the risk bar introduces first: TWO legends on one page** (proven: driving one cannot move the other figure's marks, enable its Reset, or write to its live region). No typed tips — bar's only seg is SORT, and the DV-D13 handler no-ops on it.
- **★ ds-010 CLOSED — and proven by RENDER, the currency it was found in.** Deleted `rect.dv-series{fill:var(--sc,…)}` (author CSS beat each rect's `fill=` attribute; `--sc` set on no rect ⇒ everything fell to the series-1 fallback); an anti-false-fix comment holds the line's place. Proof at **1180px AND 760px** in the licensed HSBC cut, reading computed fills: cb2 horizontal back to `rgb(87,124,120)` **series-3 (DV-D09 restored)** · cb3 status back to **4 distinct** — `rgb(185,47,30)` #B92F1E · `rgb(197,137,0)` #C58900 · green · blue (**R-D9 ramp restored**) · cb4/cb5 3 distinct each. All were a single purple before.
- **⬛ ds-012 LOGGED, NOT FIXED (new) — h-bar category labels are CLIPPED.** Same render: all six labels cut at the left edge ("Groceries"→"oceries"), measured per label via `getBBox()` — worst case 54.8px of text into a 38px gutter, **16.8px overflow**, 6 of 6. Cause is [[univers-measured-facts]] biting GEOMETRY: a gutter sized against a fallback face, not the looser licensed cut. Fixing re-bakes the figure — **Dave's call**, two candidate shapes + a recommended (browser-dependent) gated assertion in `_DS-IMPROVEMENTS.md`. **Standing pattern, twice now: ds-010 and ds-012 were BOTH found by rendering the real snippet in the real cut, and neither is reachable by any static gate we have.**
- **★ DONUT RENDER-VERIFY OWED → DISCHARGED.** Playwright staged from scratch per `_RUNBOOK-render-verify.md` (runbook held, no new potholes); exemplar shot at both widths, font assert passed. `_REVIEW-SIGNOFF.md` updated.
- **⬛ AWAITING DAVE (registered in `_REVIEW-SIGNOFF.md`, not only here):** (a) **the swatch-shape delta** — bar's `.sw-circle/.sw-square/.sw-diamond` are now plain squares, because bar's marks are rects and its real non-colour channel is the LETTER key; **Chart-line's markers genuinely ARE those shapes and keep modifiers in lane ③**, so the two members will differ on purpose. Reversible on request. (b) ds-012's fix shape. (c) the two v5.5 gate-forced deltas still outstanding from the prior session.

## ⏱ PRIOR DELTA — 2026-07-26 (Sun evening, OPUS solo self-conducting — ★ THE CAP FORK RULED + the legend model ENACTED on its first member; build 55/55 GREEN, verify 27/27; 🔴 RED ~72% wrap) — "Opened to enact DV-D11/12/13 and hit a wall in the first ten minutes: dv-behaviour.js had 858 bytes of headroom and the model needs ~14,100. Dave ruled the deferred cap fork (§C·2 #18) — SPLIT the source AND re-scope the gate to a per-page budget — then ruled incremental migration. Chart-donut now runs the real model; bar, combo and line follow."

- **★ THE 16KB CAP FORK — RULED (§C·2 #18 CLOSED).** Measured three ways before asking: one file would land at 26,615 B as-written · 22,364 B comment-stripped · 21,327 B even with DV-D12 abandoned. None passed. Dave ruled **split AND re-scope**: `canon/dv-legend.js` joins as a second registered `$behaviour` source, the 16KB per-source cap is renamed to a LEGIBILITY constraint, and a **32KB per-GROUP PAGE budget** (`check_group`/`PAGE_BYTES`) is added so splitting can never buy headroom. Inscribed as **ADR-0015 § Amendment (2026-07-26)**, both beats. WHY/HOW: `_DECISION-HISTORY/2026-07-26-behaviour-cap-fork-and-legend-enactment.md`.
- **★ SAME DEFECT FOUND TWICE:** the "exactly ONE rAF-debounced resize listener" check was also per-source and would have failed dv-legend for carrying ZERO — correct for a source with nothing to reflow. Moved to group level under the same ruling. Gate ships **5 new selftest bites**, including the evasion case (two sources each under 16KB, together over 32KB). Selftest OK.
- **★ MINIFICATION ASKED + DECLINED (Dave, mid-build).** Numbers are real — 28,332 B raw → **9,622 B gzipped**, free at transport — but the cap is a COMPLEXITY forcing function, and minifying shrinks the number without simplifying the thing while letting source sprawl read green. Reference snippets carry the injected block inline and must stay readable; comments are the provenance trail; a minifier adds version-drift to a byte-exact `--check`. Wire-weight belongs in the ADR-0008 adapter layer. Reasoning recorded in the ADR amendment (Rejected, with reasons).
- **★ Chart-donut MIGRATED — the exemplar.** Dual-gesture rows (swatch `role=checkbox` OUTSIDE the isolate label button), typed tips (`data-tip-value`/`data-tip-percent`), sr-only live region, Reset canon-disabled (B-D4). **Verified 27/27** by `knowledge/_verify_dv_legend.js` — the REAL source driven against the REAL snippet in jsdom, incl. Dave's signed-off figures (isolate Housing 950/41%, +Savings 1250/54%), the "nothing ever hides" invariant, additive isolate, the 24%/12% ladder, and rest-to-rest sweep landing exactly on baked geometry.
- **★ TWO MISSES IN THE HANDOFF'S DIVVY, found by grep not by assumption:** (1) **the wave is FOUR members, not three** — `Chart-line` carries a legend (3 rows) and was in no lane; (2) **`.lg` COLLIDES with canon's `.seg.lg`** ("legend" vs "large") — the blast-radius gate caught it on first build; family renamed **`.dv-leg*`**. State classes `.is-ghost`/`.is-faded`/`.is-peek` KEPT — DV-D11 inscribes them verbatim.
- **★ TRANSITIONAL COEXISTENCE (Dave ruled incremental).** The two models are **selector-disjoint** (`button[data-series-toggle]` vs `.dv-legrow`), so members migrate one at a time with every commit working. The old block sits behind a marked TRANSITIONAL header with an executable end condition (`grep -l data-series-toggle knowledge/snippets/Chart-*.reference.html` returns nothing). `dv-legend`'s universal contract is **empty BY DESIGN** meanwhile, hooks riding each migrated member's extraContract, with the promotion instruction written in.
- **⚠ GATES BIT THE RESURRECTED WORK, as the rule says they should:** the signed-off v5.5 CSS failed DEF-005 (`padding:5px 9px`) and the radius gate (`border-radius:2px`). Corrected to **4px/8px** + `var(--border-radius-default)`. **Two small visual deltas from what Dave signed off — flagged for his eye, registered in `_REVIEW-SIGNOFF.md`, not buried.**
- **Build/verify:** `_build_all.py` **55/55 GREEN**; behaviour gate reports per-source 12,682 + 15,650 and page budget **31,268 B (95%)** during transition, **28,332 B (86%)** once the transitional block goes. Library 67. Seed fed (82 nodes / 146 edges).
- **⬛ OPEN, flagged not decided:** (a) `Chart-sparkline` now carries an **inert 15.6KB payload** — injection is group-wide and the registry has no per-member behaviour opt-in; (b) **page budget already at 86%** — the next behaviour addition faces this same fork, by design; (c) `_verify_dv_legend.js` is **unwired** (needs jsdom, not a build dependency) — wire as advisory or vendor?; (d) **graph `--verify` drift**: 5 seed edges unmatched incl. this session's 2 — the parser has **no convention for an ADR AMENDMENT carrying its own node**. Logged, not fudged.
- **🔴 Gauge at authoring: RED ~72% (in-head tally, ESTIMATE ±15%).** ⇒ **NEXT READER RE-VERIFY before building on this:** re-run `_build_all.py` + `node knowledge/_verify_dv_legend.js`, and spot-check the byte figures above.
- **OPEN → NEXT WINDOW:** migrate **Chart-bar** (+ **ds-010**: kill `fill:var(--sc,…)` at `Chart-bar.reference.html:102`), **Chart-combo** (+ DV-D10 axis-proximate lockups), **Chart-line**. Donut is the copy-source. On the last one: delete the transitional block, promote `class="dv-legrow` to the universal contract, drop it from the four extraContracts, re-run the gate (page budget should fall to 86%).

## ⏱ PRIOR DELTA — 2026-07-25 (Sat night, OPUS solo — Red-handoff re-verified GREEN → donut sweep easing restored (v5.2) + two-step fade redesign (v5.3); both REVIEW CANDIDATES; 🟡 AMBER ~55% wrap at Dave's call) — "Opened as the v5.1 sign-off; became prototype tuning at Dave's direction. Nothing inscribed — Dave has more changes coming; next window continues on v5.3."

- **★ RED HANDOFF RE-VERIFIED (first action, per the Red-scrutiny rule):** ran `python3 knowledge/_build_all.py` cold → **53/53 GREEN** (a11y · dataviz · integrity all pass). The prior session's "landed" claims (v5.1 bar-key rise, hit-area canon patch) hold. Library still **67**.
- **★ v5.2 — DONUT SWEEP EASING RESTORED — `reviews/LEGEND-ISOLATE-TOGGLE-PROTOTYPE-2026-07-24-v5.2.html`.** Dave flagged a lost finesse: the radial-sweep intro should ease-IN across the first segment, run LINEAR through the middle, ease-OUT across the last. On-disk v3→v5.1 was plain **linear** (`ang = start+(end−start)·p`) — the finesse dropped in a rebuild. Restored in `sweepDonut` as a **trapezoidal angular-velocity profile keyed to segment spans**: `V=(S+w1+wN)/dur`; accel covers exactly segment-1's width, decel exactly the last's, constant cruise between. ⚠ The real donut's **segment A is 147°** (41% of the circle) → the ease-in is a long ~441ms ramp (>half the 850ms); Dave to judge if that reads sluggish (one-line tunable). **Verified numerically** (node): ang@0=start · ang@dur=end · monotonic · endpoint velocity ≈0 · cruise velocity flat =V. JS `--check` clean. Self-contained rAF (canon-independent).
- **★ v5.3 — TWO-STEP FADE — `reviews/…-v5.3.html` (Dave's ruling).** Hover fade **.18→.24**; ISOLATE now **ghosts the non-focused series to 12%** (`.is-ghost`) instead of hiding them at 0%. To do it cleanly, **isolate became its OWN state layer** (`isolated` var) separate from the checkbox `visible[]` flags → **three render levels: full / ghost(12%) / gone(0%, checkbox-removed)** via a new `paint(id,level)`. Hover suppressed while isolated (isolate owns the dimming); touching a swatch exits isolate mode. **Logic sim 12/12 PASS** (full/ghost/gone truth table across isolate·release·checkbox·reset·guards); JS `--check` clean; CSS levels confirmed present.
- **⬛ TWO DESIGN DEFAULTS — PENDING DAVE'S CONFIRM (I chose, flagged, vetoable):** (a) the **swatch checkbox still fully removes** (0%) — only isolate ghosts to 12% (remove ≠ focus); (b) while isolated **hover doesn't stack**, and **any swatch toggle exits isolate**. Confirm or retune next window.

## ⏱ PRIOR DELTA — 2026-07-25 (Sat morning, OPUS solo — legend FEEL RULED by Dave → prototype v4 built + render-verified + review overlay cut → Dave's 5 review edits captured to the v5 brief; Amber WRAP at Dave's call ~58%) — "★ Dave ruled the legend feel: CLICK-TO-ISOLATE + RESET (settles the open a11y call = toggle-buttons, NOT radiogroup). v4 rebuilt on the real charts with his 5 points + 2 refinements, render-verified light+dark @2 widths + isolate states both themes, real HSBC font. NOT yet inscribed to canon — Dave has 'a bunch of things to fix', pinned via the .REVIEW overlay; those annotations open the next window."

- **★ LEGEND FEEL RULED (Dave, supersedes the v3 'feel still the gate' line below).** Model = **click a legend item to ISOLATE that series · Reset shows all (disabled until a key is clicked)**. Because the resting state is "all shown" and a click isolates, these are **exclusive toggle-buttons (`aria-pressed`), NOT a `radiogroup`** — a radiogroup needs one persistent selection the "all" state doesn't have. The open a11y call from v1–v3 is therefore CLOSED by the chosen model.
- **★ v4 BUILT — `reviews/LEGEND-ISOLATE-TOGGLE-PROTOTYPE-2026-07-24-v4.html`** (real Chart-bar cb4 + Chart-donut cd1 verbatim; real type.css + dv-behaviour.js linked). Dave's ruling pass, point by point:
  1. **Hover-fade restored** (from the original exemplar): rolling over a series — legend item OR the bar/segment — fades the OTHER series' bars/segments AND their letter keys (`.is-faded` opacity .18, `!important` to outrank entry motion; wired to legend + `.dv-series` mouseenter/focus).
  2. **Bar swatches = plain SQUARES like the donut** (Dave: "the shapes don't reference anything" — dropped the circle/diamond shape-coding); on-chart bar keys stay bare letters (no shapes/badges).
  3. **Donut: "Reset" under the last legend item** + the **radial-sweep INTRO restored**, driven from the canon sweep contract (`data-cx/-cy/-ro/-ri/-a1/-a2` + `data-seq`) with a self-contained rAF arc generator (matched to the baked `d` — faithful, not invented).
  4. **Bar: legend keys ranged LEFT, "Reset" right-aligned inline** same row (`margin-left:auto`); Reset **disabled until a key is clicked**.
  5. **No "only"/"Showing only X" text, no strike-through.** OFF state = box border + text muted to the **lowest grey PRIMITIVE that still passes small-text AA 4.5:1 = mono/7 `#626262` (light, 6.10:1) / mono/9 `#9D9D9D` (dark, 6.42:1)** — i.e. the existing `--data-axis`; mono/8 `#808080` FAILS both (3.95 / 4.41). Bound to a `--muted` var (= `--data-axis`). *(Dave's refinement: must be a grey in the grey primitives, not an arbitrary computed hex — so #767676/#828282 rejected in favour of the ramp step.)*
- **⚠ INTERPRETATION CALLS I made (flagged to Dave, vetoable):** (a) dropped v3's separate additive-checkbox swatch → the model is now purely isolate+reset (matches his instructions); (b) Reset disabled-until-click applied to the DONUT too (meaningless with nothing isolated); (c) kept a **sr-only live region** (no visible chrome) so isolate state is announced — honours "no feedback labels" visually while staying accessible.
- **RENDER-VERIFIED** per `_RUNBOOK-render-verify.md`: light+dark @1180 + 560, plus isolate states both themes (bar series-2 / donut series-1), `document.fonts.check('16px HSBC_MtUnivers_Latin')` = true on every shot, bg confirmed `rgb(26,26,26)` dark. 6 PNGs in the outputs mount (agent self-verify only; Dave reviews the HTML). **Pipeline note re-banked:** the sandbox `$HOME` **rotates between calls** (cache + pip don't survive) and the bash cap is a **hard 45s** — so download+libs+fonts+render must run in ONE call; it fit (~40s, warm mirror). One harness gotcha caught + fixed: setting `data-theme` via evaluate then screenshotting immediately caught the 160ms theme cross-fade mid-flight (greyed everything) — re-shot dark via `add_init_script` on DOMContentLoaded + settle wait.
- **REVIEW OVERLAY CUT — `reviews/LEGEND-ISOLATE-TOGGLE-PROTOTYPE-2026-07-24-v4.REVIEW.html`** (via `knowledge/_review/_make_review.py`; comment pins + export-to-prompt). Dave has **"a bunch of things to fix"** to pin on it → its export becomes the **next window's opener**. **v4 is a REVIEW CANDIDATE, not canon** — the legend ruling is NOT inscribed to `_DATAVIZ-DECISIONS`/ADR yet (waits on Dave's sign-off of the fixed version).
- **⬛ STILL DAVE'S OPEN CALL — ds-010** (`_DS-IMPROVEMENTS.md`, unchanged): fold the one-line `Chart-bar` `fill:var(--sc,…)` drop into the bar lane of the wave, **or** fix it now + rebuild. v4 carries the workaround so its bars show the intended 3 colours.
- **⚠ WAVE FLAG (donut intro × 16KB cap):** restoring the animated sweep in CANON is the deferred `dv-behaviour.js` sweep hook, which pushes the module past the **16KB gate** — so the cap-fork decision (amend the cap vs modularise per family, deferred item 3) rides the donut lane, not now.
- **Build/commit:** no canon/token/snippet edits → build stays **53/53**, library **67**. On disk (uncommitted): v4 + v4.REVIEW review artefacts + this spine delta. Nothing committed yet (Amber tier — no GOOD-MORNING/rename/fresh window; full wrap is Dave's call).
- **★ REVIEW ROUND (Dave, via the overlay) — 5 change requests pinned → brief `notes/_briefs/2026-07-25-legend-v5-review-edits-brief.md` (v5 build, next window).** Headline: **RESTORE the dual checkbox-swatch + isolate-label** (v4's isolate-only was Dave-VETOED — "I can't check the swatches") · off-rows = **resting + hollow-grey swatch** (NOT muted item — supersedes the earlier point-5 mute-to-grey-primitive; grey primitive → swatch border only) · **Reset canon-disabled default** (B-D4: #9D9D9D/#808080 text, `--line` border) / enabled = light-border+dark-text · **bar key-alpha animates with the grow** · **`.seg:hover` border→ink**. Kept: square swatches · donut Reset-under-last + sweep · hover-fade · no strike/"only".

Render-verify pipeline is now WORKING in-sandbox. The redo caught a real canon bug — grouped/stacked/horizontal/status bars all render series-1 purple. Legend FEEL ruling STILL the gate for the wave."

- **Render-verify pipeline STOOD UP + WORKING this session** (the standing OWED blocker — cleared for this work): Playwright headless-shell + `~/.local/chromelibs` + fontconfig alias per `knowledge/_RUNBOOK-render-verify.md`. ⚠ One addition to bank: the alias must cover **BOTH** font strings — `"Univers Next for HSBC"` (snippet `--font`) AND `"Univers Next HSBC"` (type.css `--uf`); the second was missing and chart composite text falls back without it. (Env is per-sandbox, re-run the runbook next session.)
- **Legend prototype → v3 is LIVE; v1/v2 DEAD.** `reviews/LEGEND-ISOLATE-TOGGLE-PROTOTYPE-2026-07-24-v3.html` embeds the REAL `Chart-bar` grouped-column (cb4) + `Chart-donut` spider (cd1) SVG **verbatim** (geometry, tokens, A/B/C + A–E letters, leaders, centre total, shaped legend swatches) + LINKS real `type.css` + `dv-behaviour.js` (popover/table/value⇄%/fit all genuine). **ONLY the legend changed** to the ruled model: swatch = checkbox (additive, canon hollow-off) · label = isolate (exclusive, radio-feel). Render-verified light+dark @2 widths, real font, + an interaction state. (v1 = toy SVGs; v2 = toy SVGs, layout fixed — Dave: "charts must be as specced," hence v3.)

Gate passed because dv-016 checks DECLARED tokens, not the CSS-collapsed render ([[gate-blindspot-state-contrast]]); render-verify was OWED on these snippets and never run — that's what caught it. **Fix = drop the `fill` declaration** (let attributes stand); applied as a WORKAROUND in v3 so its bars show the intended 3 colours. **Canon UNTOUCHED — Dave's call:** fold the one-liner into the bar lane of the wave, or fix `Chart-bar` now + re-run build.

## ⏱ PRIOR DELTA — 2026-07-24 (Fri PM, OPUS solo — O1 "dark-in-light" RULED + DV-D10 minted + inscribed; mechanism BUILD teed up) — "★ O1 DESIGN LOCKED, records on tattoos, build 53/53 green — the MECHANISM BUILD is the remaining piece (turnkey spec below). Dave ruled the design by number + ruled DV-D10 (combo labelling) by eye on a live compare sheet."

- **★ O1 (scoped inverse surface) — DESIGN RULED, inscribed as ADR-0014 addendum (Decisions 7+8).** Dave confirmed sub-decisions 1–5: naming **`data-surface="inverse"`** (extends the existing `page|raised` value set) · **re-resolution (O1)** not paired `on-*` tokens (O2) · **ink + hairlines only**, RAG/fills untouched · **always inverse-resolved, never double-inverted** (island declares itself, not "flip vs parent") · slice = donut on-segment keys + a dark card, NOT the combo. **★ VERIFIED CORRECTION to the brief:** `type26-013` ("white=red-only") is **doctrine with NO running gate** (asserted-only) — the gate that actually bites chart text is **`dv-016`** (≥3:1 vs the declared `data-surface`). So the gate work is **NOT "exempt white text"** — it is **extend `data-surface` with `inverse` + compute contrast vs the inverse ground** (white scores 4.6–5.3:1, passes with teeth intact). Stronger than an exemption; `type26-013` gets a doctrine carve-out only.
- **★ DV-D10 minted (combo/line labelling) — RULED BY EYE** on `reviews/COMBO-LABELLING-SOLUTIONS-2026-07-24-v1.html` (4 live panels + width slider). **COMBO:** drop the on-chart line-end letter; series identity → **axis-proximate legend lockups** (swatch mirrors the mark: chip=bar, line+node=line; + series name; proximity=which axis). **LINE alone:** keep the direct end-label = **shape + letter** (belt-and-braces; its end has guaranteed page-air) — the **letter is droppable** once shape+named-label present, **Dave checking his a11y team** first. Standards basis checked: dv-006 "both axes" = TOOLTIP not permanent labels · dv-011/§04.3 met by shape+text · W3C 1.4.1 + direct-labelling-preferred + the `<table>` = long-desc. **DV-D10 REMOVES the combo end-key from O1's scope.**
- **Inscribed + green:** DV-D10 → `_DATAVIZ-DECISIONS.md` (with Edges) · O1 → `ADR-0014` addendum (Decisions 7+8, full sub-decision record) · decision-graph fed (nodes DV-D10 + ADR-0014, edges; graph builds 78n/137e, my edges resolve, the 4 orphan warns are the pre-existing un-seeded ADR-0013). **`_build_all.py` 53/53 GREEN** (record-only changes: 2 ledgers + seed + ADR).
- **⬛ REMAINING = THE MECHANISM BUILD (turnkey — not yet started; a brand-gate change → wants render-verify working, per the O1 brief's own "open FRESH" note):**
  1. **Token:** mint `surface/inverse/{color, on}` in `semantic-colour.json` (DV-D07 two-channel shape) — `color` → `$alias color/neutral/4` (dark ground, theme-following = digital-black substrate) · `on` → `$alias text/on-inverse` (light ink). Keep near the `surface/*` block (~line 2588).
  2. **Cascade:** a scoped rule `[data-surface="inverse"]{ --ink: <on>; --baseline/hairlines: <on/muted>; }` in `canon.css` — find the HAND-AUTHORED cascade home (near the `[data-theme]` blocks, NOT between AUTO markers). Ink + hairlines only; leave series/RAG/dataviz vars alone.
  3. **Gate:** in `_validate_dataviz.py`, when a `dv-label`/`dv-axis`/`dv-key` text node is inside a `data-surface="inverse"` context, set its `surface_key` to the inverse ground (add `--inverse` to the resolved theme vars) so dv-016 checks against the right base + **add a selftest bite** (white-on-inverse passes, dark-ink-on-inverse fails). Record the `type26-013` doctrine carve-out in the guideline.
  4. **Apply:** donut on-segment keys (`Chart-donut` `text.dv-key-el fill="var(--ink)"` → sit in `data-surface="inverse"`) + **rebuild `Chart-combo` legend as the two axis-proximate lockups + strip `.dv-endkey`** (DV-D10). `Chart-line` keeps its end-key pending Dave's a11y check. ## ⏱ PRIOR DELTA — 2026-07-21 (late night, FABLE conductor) — "★ PHASE 0 BUILT: theme-resolution layer LIVE (4 themes, one attribute) · radius = flex slot · universal harness + showroom (40) · build 42/42"
- **★ THE THEME LAYER IS LIVE (ADR-0011 mechanised).** `tokens/themes/apollo-{legacy,console,supercharge}.overrides.json` authored (Legacy = 21 paths, every value from the R-D16/R-D18/R-D20 eviction records + registry `ownsHexes`, per-line provenance; Console = radius only; Supercharge = deliberately empty). **`canon/gen_theme_cascade.py`** generates the `[data-apollo-theme]` cascade into canon.css (AUTO-THEMES block): root canonical vars + **per-component re-projections via each snippet's #token-manifest** (the projected-literal problem — root vars alone can't reach `.cn-*` literals). Both modes always emitted (no light→dark leak); selftest green.
- **★ SHAPE DE-HARDCODED (the strategy's Phase-1-flagged finding, done in Phase 0):** 37 `border-radius:0` in canon.css → `var(--border-radius-default)`; Button snippet migrated end-to-end (CSS + theme-block declarations + manifest binding; both `resolve()` fns extended to layout.json). **Console renders ROUNDED (8px = my PROVISIONAL value, Dave to rule)**; **Legacy = square RULED (Dave, in-chat today)**.
- **★ SHOWROOM + UNIVERSAL HARNESS BUILT (`gen_showroom.py` → `showroom/`, RULED shape):** one generated page per component (40) + categorised master `index.html`. Each page = the harness: 4-theme switch × light/dark panes side-by-side × width slider × the snippet's live variant spread; theme carries index→page via `#theme=` (hashchange bug found by the render loop, fixed).
- **FOUR NEW BUILD STEPS, all blocking, 38→42 green:** token projection sync (`gen_snippet_tokens --check` — the run surfaced **silent drift**: T1–T9 still on pre-R-D20 Legacy error reds + 4 stale `.cn-button` literals, all corrected to already-ruled values, committed separately for attribution) · theme cascade sync · **radius gate** (`_validate_radius.py`: strict on canon + migrated snippets, advisory census = the 21-file Phase-1 worklist in `_RADIUS-GATE.md`) · showroom sync.
- **BUG caught live:** `project_canon`'s optional-prefix regex stomped AUTO-THEMES Legacy values back to Mono on re-run — cascade `--check` caught it same hour; fixed with a fence in the projector (order-independence, not run-order convention).
- **EXIT GATE MET + verified in-sandbox** (Playwright headless shell + real HSBC TTFs): Legacy red CTA + teal Done (the teal needed `rag/success-background` added — caught AT the exit gate) · Mono ink · Console rounded · **Supercharge ≡ Mono by pixel-diff (bbox None)**. Legacy `text/on-success` kept BLACK (AA 6.06:1) — historical white-on-teal (3.47:1 FAIL) queued for Dave.
- **★ SAME EVENING (Dave, on the pushed result): RADIUS IS A SEMANTIC TIER, not one token.** *"8px can't be universal — radii differ on cards and buttons; flexibility is key; ultimately we build a THEME GENERATOR from this."* Enacted immediately (before Phase 1 migrates 21 files onto the wrong binding): `layout.json` border-radius = **default + control/surface/indicator roles** ($alias→default, taxonomy PROVISIONAL-agent); `gen_canon_tokens` emits modeless alias CHAINS (`--border-radius-control: var(--border-radius-default)`); **`gen_theme_cascade` gained generic ALIAS-AWARE resolution** (override the base → every role follows; dial a role → it wins — also propagates colour alias chains, e.g. Legacy ink→icons). Canon rebound by role (21 control / 8 surface / 8 indicator); Cards migrated (2nd proof, surface role); Console demo = default 8 + surface 12 (both provisional) — **render-verified: Console cards 12px vs buttons 8px**. Build green 42/42. Theme-generator horizon inscribed in `_FUTURE-STATE.md` (style-builder entry, widened).
- **★ SAME EVENING #2 (Dave): semantic roles RATIFIED ("these are fine semantically"; values still provisional) + a COMPONENT-TYPE flex tier is QUEUED as a dedicated architecture session — recorded, deliberately NOT explored (his instruction).** Sketch: type-groups (e.g. segmented controls share one radius) in the component token tier under the semantic roles; generalises to borders + other parameters; Mono doesn't need it — other themes might, **the generator will**. Full record + open questions: `_FUTURE-STATE.md` (tiered-flex entry). Phase-1 workers unaffected — keep binding semantic ROLE tokens.
- **NEXT: Phase 1** — finalise the 40 through the harness (conductor + 2 Fable workers): radius migration per component (the 20-file ratchet, **binding ROLE tokens** control/surface/indicator), theme-response audit, sign-off into the showroom. **Parallel worker delivered mid-capture: designer pack v2 SHIPPED** (`Apollo-designer-skills-v2.zip`, baked from `7071538`, no-script model ruled by Dave; receipt `notes/_receipts/2026-07-21-worker-designer-pack-v2.md`; v2.1 re-bake post-push picks up the override sets). History: `_DECISION-HISTORY/2026-07-21-phase0-theme-resolution-layer.md`.

## ⏱ PRIOR DELTA — 2026-07-21 (night, OPUS solo / self-conductor) — "ADR-0007 part 2 BUILT · gauge thresholds aligned · component build-out STRATEGY authored (showroom + Fable model)"
- **★ COMPONENT BUILD-OUT STRATEGY authored → `_BUILDOUT-STRATEGY-2026-07-21.md`** (the execution seed for the next 2 days; ~50% token budget to burn before Thu-night renewal). **3 phases:** (0) clean room — SERIAL — build the `[data-apollo-theme]` resolution layer (colour + neutral-ramp + **shape/radius** axes) + the universal review harness (4 themes × light/dark × responsive × variant spread) + the showroom folder; (1) finalise the 40 existing Mono components through the harness — PARALLEL; (2) build the ~50 itinerary gaps at pace — PARALLEL. **Fable model:** conductor + **2 Fable workers** (Dave), fenced by the 38 blocking gates + harness + an Opus verify pass — parallelism is the burn lever, gates are the fence; serialise Phase 0, parallelise 1–2 only.
- **Dave's theme rulings (slot-POPULATION under ADR-0011 + ADR-0010 — NOT new architecture, do NOT write a new ADR):** Console + Supercharge **inherit Mono's palette**; dataviz + status/RAG colours **identical across Mono/Console/Supercharge** (only Legacy differs); per-theme flex on **UI greys + border-radius + a future input-error colour**, all token-bound never hardcoded; **Console = rounded corners** now; declare **`null` placeholder slots on Mono** for anticipated flex (input-error) so values can be added any time (ADR-0010 declared-but-unset, gate-guarded). **Showroom RULED:** generated folder = **one file per component + one master categorised-library `index.html`**; snippets+canon.css+tokens stay the gated source; `reviews/` demoted to scratch.
- **FINDING (Phase-1 task):** `canon.css` **hardcodes `border-radius:0`** on button/list-items/etc. — a theme override can't round Console's corners until these rebind to `var(--border-radius-default)`. De-hardcoding shape is now an explicit finalise task (+ a gate so new hardcodes fail). `border-radius` is already a token (`layout.json`); no "corners" ADR — it's one more flex slot under ADR-0010.
- **✅ ADR-0007 PART 2 BUILT (the deferred generator half).** `_build_live_state.py` now consumes the parsed graph (`_decision-graph.json`) and **regenerates the decision-node lifecycle block** (LIVE/AMENDED/DEAD/OPEN + supersession + dead-claim) between new `AUTO-DECISION-LIFECYCLE` markers in `_LIVE-STATE.md` — the spine now *shows* the do-not-build-on set to a cold session. Deterministic (no volatile date → no spurious diff), idempotent, **verified an exact derived view of the graph state (55/6/8/1)**. `_build_all.py` reordered (graph before live-state). ADR-0007 Consequences updated (part 2 = done; §5 correctness-audit still open). Build green **38/38**.
- **✅ CONTEXT GAUGE thresholds aligned:** amber **0.45 → 0.50**, red held **0.60** (`_context_gauge.py` + runbook). ⚠️ **DRIFT CAUGHT:** the HOUSEKEEPING line claimed the 0.50 move was done 2026-07-20 but the engine still read 0.45 — recorded-never-applied; actually applied today (Dave: "move red to 60% too" — red was already 0.60; the 70% recalled is long superseded).
- **CONFLICT GATE — RULED stays ADVISORY (Dave, "what's safest").** All 8 registered tensions carry a resolution + 1 intentional divergence (DEF-006⇹DEF-005) → `--strict` passes clean today. Per ADR-0005 §5 bite-test the gate + its day-old parser haven't earned blocking yet. **Promotion criterion (recorded):** promote after ~3 clean sessions, specifically once it's stayed silent through work that *added* decision edges (the RAG follow-ons / theme-provenance flip) — that's the real false-positive proof.
- **NEXT:** open a fresh chat for **Phase 0** (per the strategy) — conductor + 2 Fable workers. History: `_DECISION-HISTORY/2026-07-21-buildout-strategy-and-adr0007-part2.md`.

## ⏱ PRIOR DELTA — 2026-07-21 (evening, SONNET workers + OPUS conductor) — "Decision-graph edges INSCRIBED — 94/94 verified, parser+diff live; audit-miss caught + reconciled (E2)"
- **The inscription pass ran (two Sonnet workers, Opus conducting).** Enacted ADR-0012 + Dave's two rulings this session: (1) ADR→ADR edges live in native `**Extends:**`/`**Relates:**` headers (not inline lines); (2) the 9 non-ledger edges (charter / def / guideline-rule nodes) inscribed **at source** in their own files; all other edges = inline `Edges:` lines in the ledgers. `parse_inline_edges()` implemented (was a stub) + a `--verify`/`--diff` mode added; a latent seed+inline **double-count bug** in `main()` fixed (would have over-counted every inscribed edge). **Verify: 94/94 matched, zero mismatch; build green 38/38.** Committed **`4a6f442`** (Dave to push via GitHub Desktop).
- **★ AUDIT-MISS CAUGHT + RECONCILED (erratum E2).** The Fable seed had omitted two edges already declared in ratified ADR headers — **ADR-0010 refines ADR-0004** (WCAG AA floor) and **ADR-0011 relates R-D17** (Legacy-leak gate). A worker first *trimmed the headers* to match the incomplete seed; reversed — **headers restored, both edges added to the seed** (92→94 edges). **RULE (new): on header-vs-seed disagreement the ratified header wins — add to the seed, never trim the header.** E2 logged in the seed errata.
- **Also corrected: a mid-session false claim of my own** that "the ADR headers carry no edges" — a line-anchored grep missed the inline `**Extends:**`/`**Relates:**` fields; every ADR (0006–0012) carries them, so the original GOOD-MORNING claim was right. The exact confident-false-inscription failure mode — caught + retracted same session.
- **★ RULED + ENACTED (Dave, 2026-07-21) — TWO-TIER context gauge.** Compaction is tiered: **Amber → light spine-flush** (capture-ritual step 1 only — refresh `_LIVE-STATE`, session continues, no `GOOD-MORNING`/rename/fresh window); **Red → the full ritual + fresh session** as before. Wired into `_RUNBOOK-context-gauge.md` (new "two tiers" section) + `_RUNBOOK-capture-ritual.md` "when to run". Context: native platform equivalents now exist (memory tool GA · context-editing · compaction beta `compact-2026-01-12`) but aren't exposed as Cowork knobs — our ritual is the hand-rolled version.
- **NEXT:** ADR-0007 **part 2** (remaining temporal-decision-graph scope) · consider promoting the conflict gate advisory→blocking once the corpus settles. History: `_DECISION-HISTORY/2026-07-21-decision-graph-inscription-and-audit-miss.md`.

## ⏱ PRIOR DELTA — 2026-07-21 (afternoon, FABLE cold) — "Decision-graph edge convention AUTHORED (ADR-0012 proposed) — corpus audited, generator + conflict gate built, 8 rulings await Dave"
- **The pinned Fable session ran: audit → convention → build, in that order.** Full-corpus read (4 ledgers whole + 11 ADRs + REVIEW register): **69 nodes / 88 edges** — the "~35 nodes" estimate was ~2× light. Three edge vocabularies found already live (DataViz front-matter `refines/governs/gated_by` · ADR `Extends/Relates` · target-doc §6) → convention = small core + **alias map, normalised in views, sources not rewritten**.
- **★ ADR-0012 (PROPOSED, not accepted):** 7 edge types (`supersedes · refines · subsumes · bounds · conflicts-with · diverges-from · verified-by`) + qualifiers `scope=`/`claim=` (audit-forced: R-D16 supersedes col25-011 *scope=mono*; R-D11 kills only R-D10's *claim*, dark values stay ruled → new **AMENDED** state) + `diverges-from` for recorded deliberate divergence (DEF-005 vs DEF-006 "do not reconcile").
- **★ BUILT + green (NOT wired into `_build_all.py` — Decision 8):** `knowledge/_build_decision_graph.py` — generator (LIVE/AMENDED/DEAD/OPEN + reconciliation view + what-touches-this + validation rollup → `_DECISION-GRAPH.md`) + conflict gate (`--strict`; selftest bites on unresolved/open/orphan, stays green on queued/diverges). Seed = `notes/_decision-graph-seed-2026-07-21.json` (the audited edges, judgment half done).
- **🟡 TWO LIVE CONFLICTS QUEUED FOR DAVE (never auto-resolved):** **C1** R-D2 "red/green/blue same value both roles" vs the R-D18/R-D20 per-role splits (claim dead, unmarked) · **C2** R-D7 "red mode-stable, one value" vs R-D20's per-mode error-glyph `#B92F1E`/`#CC4333` (unrecorded fill-role bound?). Both `resolution=queued` in the seed. Errata E1: GOOD-MORNING said "T-D1…T-D16"; ledger holds T-D1..14 (fixed this capture).
- **★ RULED same day — ALL 8 recommendations ACCEPTED (Dave: "I'm happy with all the recommendations").** ADR-0012 **proposed→ACCEPTED** · C1+C2 recorded as **R-D21** (`_RAG-DECISIONS.md`, the first entry carrying an `Edges:` line): R-D2's role-uniformity claim **superseded**; R-D7 **bounded to the fill role** (no values change) · seed conflicts flipped queued→ruled(ref=R-D21) · **`_build_decision_graph.py` WIRED advisory** into `_build_all.py` (step 11/38). Graph: **70 nodes · 92 edges · 0 queued · 0 warnings**; **build green 38/38**. Session closed RED (~80%) → inscription pass = fresh SONNET session (transcribe seed → `Edges:` lines, verify by generator diff; R-D21 is the template). History: `_DECISION-HISTORY/2026-07-21-decision-graph-edge-convention.md`.

- **The RAG-completion tuner ran, Dave ruled, tokens applied.** Cloned the R-D18 success tuner to three sets (`reviews/RAG-ERROR-WARNING-INFO-2026-07-20-v1.html`). Signal colours were NOT re-decided (already ruled); the open slot per set = the message **tint**, re-hued off Legacy. **Build green 37/37.**
- **Tints ruled (Dave, live tuner):** error `#F1E0DC`/`#2C120D` · warning `#F6E5CC`/`#3C2C13` (Dave lifted the dark to keep it amber, not brown) · information `#D6E3EC`/`#092131`. All labels 12.9–16.8:1. `$alias` dropped on the three tint tokens (direct Mono values, cf. success-tint).
- **Bare roles rebased off Legacy → track the glyph** (as `rag/success` did): `rag/error`→`rag/error-glyph` (`#B92F1E`/`#CC4333`) · `rag/warning`→`rag/warning-glyph` (`#C58900`) · `rag/information`→`rag/information-glyph` (`#306EC6`/`#2674DC`). Notes stamped R-D20 in `semantic-colour.json`.
- **6 Mono snippets swept** to match (Account-card, Dropdown, Input-fields, List-items, Selection-controls, Status-indicator) — parallel to the 7 de-tealed for success. **Notifications NOT converted** (§A-AUTH DO-NOT-CONVERT — it's a Legacy reference): its RAG vars are `driftAllow`-waived in the snippet gate, proper fix = retag to Legacy theme (future build).
- **★ UNBLOCKS Alert / Banner / Toast** (§C·3). Ledger: `_RAG-DECISIONS.md` R-D20 (top). **Still deferred:** `tabs/active` + `progress/complete` (unruled Mono values, archived consumers). **Theme-provenance gate stays ADVISORY** — flipping to blocking still needs the broader foreign-hex cleanup (**58 hexes / 67 files**, down from 68); that's the parked archived-file relocation, not this ruling.
- **RULE SHARPENED — R-D6 Ruling A′ (glyph contrast), committed `1bb09f9`.** Dave: the only coloured icons in Apollo are RAG statuses, each labelled or drawn with a passing black/white internal mark (warning roundel's black `!` = 11.06:1 on amber) — colour is never the sole channel, so **no status glyph is held to 4.5**; the 3:1 indicator floor governs. The 4.5 text rule's live domain is the **meaning-exclusive glyph** (arrow-as-datum, coloured mark beside a bare number). Bounds `{#icon-011}`'s "all instances" reading; subsumes the R-D3 amber roundel-leg exemption. Recorded in R-D6 A′ + scope note on `{#icon-011}` + folded into `{#icon-015}` (regenerates into `_RECONCILIATION.md`).
- **★ STRUCTURAL QUESTION OPENED → next build (Fable, cold).** Reconciling icon-011↔R-D6↔R-D3 by hand exposed that decision records cross-reference in **prose**, so recall = keyword search + reconciliation = manual. Desk research: this is **already decided** (ADR-0007 temporal decision-graph); the unbuilt half = **typed edges between records + a reconciliation view/gate**. Verdict: don't replicate (rot engine) and don't build a graph DB (tool-temptation) — author the **edge convention** (~35 nodes: refines/supersedes/subsumes/bounds/conflicts-with/verified-by) + generator (LIVE/DEAD/OPEN + reconciliation view + "what-touches-this" map) + **conflict gate**. **Tasked to Fable** (high-stakes, hands-off; conflicts it finds are queued for Dave, not auto-resolved). Full arc: `_DECISION-HISTORY/2026-07-21-rag-completion-and-decision-graph.md`; entry in `_FUTURE-STATE.md`.

## ⏱ PRIOR DELTA — 2026-07-20 (evening 5) — "Mono teal→green sweep EXECUTED — proforma normalised, last teal evicted"
- **The pre-flighted sweep is DONE** (fresh good-morning session; **Mode-2 delegation** — a Sonnet subagent executed the verified map, Opus verified + vouched). Ran `_DECISION-HISTORY/2026-07-20-mono-sweep-map-and-bad-day.md` in one pass. Committed **`d6e3d89`** (ahead 1 — Dave to push via GitHub Desktop). **Build green 37/37; theme-provenance teal `#00847F` count in `_proforma`: 22 → 0.**
- **Change 1 — `--success`/`--success-t` vars, all 9 (Masthead + Tranche-2…9):** light `#2B7E4F`/`#DCEDE3`, dark `#4A9568`/`#12291D` (= `rag/success` + `-tint`, R-D18). **Change 2 — `#i-success` badge, Tranche-2…5 only:** hardcoded circle `#00847F` + white tick → tokenised `currentColor` circle + `path style="fill:var(--mark)"` (the T6–9/Masthead pattern; dark tick knocks to page colour).
- **OPEN sub-decision CLOSED:** dark `--success` = green `#4A9568` (small inline dot), NOT the white flip — verified against aligned `snippets/Status-indicator`. The handoff's "tick likely → black under type26-013" worry does NOT bite here: the small dot uses `--mark=--page`, so its tick already knocks to the page colour; type26-013's black-tick case is the *big roundel* (`snippets/Confirmation`), not this dot.

Mono's status *signal* colours are **already ruled** — breach red `#B92F1E` (R-D7), watch amber `#F0B13A` (R-D11), info blue `#5F92B9` (R-D10), success green (R-D18); **do not re-decide** them. The genuine open work = **completing the `error`/`warning`/`information` sets the way R-D18 did success**: the bare roles + their `-tint` slots still hold Legacy hexes (`semantic-colour.json` ~L549–643); per set, confirm the per-mode graphic value + **re-hue the tint off Legacy**, then rebind the bare role. Clone `reviews/RAG-SUCCESS-GREEN-2026-07-20-v1.html`. **Unblocks Alert/Banner/Toast.** Then flip `_validate_theme_provenance.py` to blocking. **DEFERRED (forward-looking):** `tabs/active` + `progress/complete` are unruled but their consumer components are archived — rule when rebuilt. **Deferred to a fresh session** (Dave, evening 5 — colour tuners run multiple rounds; open cold with clean budget).

## ⏱ PRIOR DELTA — 2026-07-20 (evening 3) — "Pre-flight for the Mono alignment sweep: record de-risked, worklist pinned, sweep handed to a fresh session"
- **Session opened good-morning; scoped the Mono alignment sweep but did NOT execute canon edits** (Dave: "be careful, I don't want to lose anything" + context discipline → spin a fresh session for the bulk). Baseline verified: tree clean, all pushed, **build green 37/37**.
- **★ INTEGRITY CHECK — nothing lost.** All 88 round-1→3 rulings are durably inscribed (21 clustered in `reviews/_style-consolidation-decisions-2026-07-20.json`; 20 singletons in `reviews/gen_style_consolidation_review.py` `SINGLETON_RULINGS`). Authoritative **align = 39** = 27 snippets + 1 `_review` (reconciled tab/stepper) + 11 `_proforma`.
- **★ RECORD DE-RISKED (only file changed this session): `knowledge/_STYLE-PROVENANCE.md` §backlog.** The pre-round-3 "backlog A (19 snippets)" list was STALE — it named Hero/Navigations/Progress-tracker/Tabs as align targets, but round 3 **archived** all four and kept **Notifications** as legacy-reference. Marked it superseded (struck-through, kept for audit) and wrote **§A-AUTH** — the authoritative 39-item align list + explicit DO-NOT-ALIGN (5 archived) + DO-NOT-CONVERT (Notifications) lists + per-item drift type (unblocked vs blocked). Build still green 37/37.
- **★ TRAPS a naive sweep would hit (now recorded in §A-AUTH):** (1) the stale list; (2) archived files still in the advisory gate's dir-wide scan (`MONO_DIRS`) — they leave scope via the later dedup pass, don't get Mono-edited; (3) Notifications' `#A8000B` is *correct* Legacy red — retag, never convert.
- **NEXT SESSION (Sonnet, cold start) — turnkey brief in `GOOD-MORNING.md` §C:** (a) **teal→green** on Masthead + Tranche-2…9 (`Tranche-1` has none): `#00847F` success → Mono `rag/success-glyph #4A9568` (dark ground), **preferably tokenise not hardcode**; ⚠️ **OPEN sub-decision** — the `#i-success` SVG is a filled circle with a WHITE tick; under type26-013 the tick likely → BLACK (cf. `on-success`=black) — rule before swapping the tick. (b) grey inks (`Avatar`,`Quick-actions`)→`color/mono/*` **via the grey-tint check** (surface numbers to Dave first). (c) regen `_review` copies (`_make_review.py`). **HELD for a tuner:** all red — bare `rag/error` (R-D17), `tabs/active` + `progress/complete` Mono values (R-D19). Then flip `_validate_theme_provenance.py` to blocking.


- **★ LIVE — the FOUR THEMES are now wired as an architecture, not just intent (ADR-0011).** `docs/decisions/ADR-0011-four-theme-token-architecture.md`: themes = **override sets at the semantic tier** (Mono = base · Legacy = populated override · Console + Supercharge = **declared nullable slots**, ADR-0010). Registry `tokens/themes/_themes.json` = single source of truth for which hex belongs to which theme. Mechanises R-D15. **Root cause found:** the token store had NO theme dimension — only light/dark modes — so Legacy red + Mono lived in the same flat roles (`primary/*`=#DB0011, `tabs/active`, `progress/complete`, bare `rag/error`). That is why "align to Mono" was "too loose" (Dave).
- **★ LIVE — RULING R-D19: red belongs to a THEME.** Legacy red `#DB0011`/`#A8000B` = Apollo **Legacy only** (CTA, tabs, progress, Legacy error). Apollo **Mono's only red = `#B92F1E`**, used **only** for status/RAG + dataviz (never action/nav). Any Legacy red in a Mono surface = **drift**. Source: Dave ("these reds are valid for legacy only, we have a new red for mono, only used for status and RAG"). Ledger `_proforma/_RAG-DECISIONS.md`.
- **★ LIVE — THE RECORD: `knowledge/_STYLE-PROVENANCE.md`** (Dave's ask — "clear record … don't miss this in future"). Classifies every artefact across `snippets`/`_proforma`/`_review`/`_fitness-test` by theme-era; scopes LIBRARY (align to Mono) vs `_fitness-test` (exploration = mine · research = preserve · **SME-payments journeys = ignore, test pages** per Dave). Machine mirror `reviews/_style-clusters.json`.
- **★ LIVE — VISUAL REVIEW SCREEN: `reviews/STYLE-CONSOLIDATION-REVIEW-2026-07-20-v2.html`** (Dave: "when there are duplicate patterns I need to compare visually" + "review screen … launch full screen … iframes too small"). Per-cluster picker; wrapping grid (no h-scroll); column/height/bg controls; **Open ↗** (full window) + **⤢** (fullscreen) per variant. Old exploration beside canon, theme-era + drift tags. ## ⏱ PRIOR DELTA — 2026-07-27 (Mon **later morning #4**, OPUS solo self-conducting, effort MAX — ★ **CALLS (1)(2)(3)(5) RULED BY DAVE; the 465-rule INSTRUMENT-FIT pass is BUILT, RUN and WIRED** · ★ **ds-016 — 7 LIVE GATES CITE RULES THE INDEX CANNOT SEE: 698 anchors declared, 465 indexed, 265 invisible — `aid-009` among them** · build **60/60 GREEN**; 🔴 RED ~72% at ritual) — "He said 'most robust methods', so the tool was built so it could not guess. Then bite 1 failed on its first run and the failure was the finding: the rule the a11y gate enforces is not in the rules index at all."

- **★ CALL (3) DELIVERED — `knowledge/_build_instrument_fit.py`, the instrument ladder at corpus scale.** I0 STATIC (source bytes) → I1 DOM (parsed tree) → I2 RENDER (computed/composited/geometric) → I3 EYE (judgment, never a defect). **Sits ON TOP of ADR-0016:** the register asks *is there a check and can it fail*; this asks *can it observe the property at all*. Generated `_INSTRUMENT-FIT.md` + `_instrument-fit.json`, **11 bites**, wired **advisory** as build steps 58 (selftest) + 59 (report) per the P3 posture.
- **★ MEASURED: 465 rules — UNDER-INSTRUMENTED 12 · UNGATED 165 · UNTAGGED 279 · EYE-ONLY 4 · FIT 5.** ⚠ **The limit is stated first, not buried: 279 of 465 (60%) are UNTAGGED**, so **12 is a FLOOR, not an answer.** Deliberately NOT fixed by widening patterns until the report went quiet — that is anti-false-fix #2 in the tool's own header, and it would convert a measured finding into a tuned one. **Two of the 12 are BLOCKING and both are contrast rules with STATIC gates:** `dv-016` (chart titles/axis/gridlines) and `icon-011` (*"icons require 4.5:1 in all instances"*). **Contrast is a COMPOSITED property** — a static parse reads the declared hex, not what lands on screen. Same class as ds-010 · ds-013 · DV-D15, now four proven instances.
- **★ ds-016 — THE FINDING NOBODY WENT LOOKING FOR, and it is ds-015 INVERTED.** Bite 1 asserted the ds-015 ground truth and returned `None`: **`aid-009` is not in `_rules-index.json`.** Chasing it: `guidelines/*.md` declares **698** rule anchors; the index holds the **465** carrying an enforcement-destiny tag; the other **265 are invisible** to the index, `_consult.py`, the enactment register and this pass — and **7 of them are cited by a live gate as its authority** (`aca-003` · `aca-004` · **`aid-009`** · `aid-020` · `avd-006` · `axs-003` · `nam-001`). `aid-009` is Dave's 2026-07-03 hit-area ruling, named 5× by `_validate_a11y.py`; **its anchor line simply never got a destiny tag.** Mirror image in the same family: **`icon-005` (BLOCKING, 44×44 target) IS indexed and NO gate names it.** ⇒ There the gate couldn't see the component; **here the INDEX can't see the rule** — markup correct, lookup fails, nothing reports it. ⚠ **The 265 are excluded BY DESIGN, not by bug; the defect is the SILENCE.** LOGGED not fixed — the remedy is call (4)'s discussion, unruled.
- **⚠ THE BITES CAUGHT THREE DEFECTS IN MY OWN TOOL, ALL ON FIRST RUN.** (1) A crude bare-word probe read **three** gates as RENDER — `_validate_proforma.py`, `_validate_token_tiers.py`, `_validate_type_composites.py` — matching the word **chrome**, as in *mono*chrome and *demo-*chrome. ⚠ **Wrong direction: it makes gates look STRONGER than they are**, which in a fitness audit buys silence. (2) `icon-005` came out **FIT** with `_build_instrument_fit.py` itself as the evidence — **a register that NAMES a rule was counting as a check that ENFORCES it**; fixed with `NOT_A_GATE` (this file + `_build_enactment_register.py`, same exposure). (3) bite 1's failure ⇒ ds-016. **Third session running for "assume your probe is wrong in the direction that reads as green".**

Sweep is retroactive and needs no cooperation — **proven the same day, it found the 7 dangling citations laid down months apart** — but reports late and **its own coverage is unmeasured** (blind to 265 rules, can't classify 279 more; nothing revealed that until a second check was built). ⇒ **The only way to detect a MISSING declaration is to sweep for it**, so the sweep is what makes adoption-time enforceable. Held shape: **adoption-time forcing function + a sweep narrowed to one job, finding undeclared adoptions.**

> have been already, the webfont needed Ultralight added, I think this is only procedural, and low
> risk."* **The commercial judgement is his and recorded as made — do not re-litigate it.**

**Split the question in two. Only one half is about risk.**

**(1) LICENCE — procedural, pending, low-risk. Owner: BRAND, chased by Dave.** The renewal is in
flight; the delta is a *weight* (**Ultralight**) being added. Write **"renewal pending; Dave assesses
the gap as procedural and low-risk"** — never "we have no licence".

**(2) ASSETS — unchanged, and NOT a risk question.** Verified by inventory: **zero Latin
`.woff`/`.woff2` files exist in the repo** (five script packs present; Latin has none). A favourable
licence does not deliver files — shareable real-face material stays blocked until the pack physically
lands, because there is nothing to embed.

**✅ DISTRIBUTION — CLOSED, ruled "leave".** The four tracked files embedding base64 woff2 stay. No
`git rm --cached`, no BFG, no history rewrite. Repo is private (confirmed by Dave) and shared only to
HSBC employees — every recipient sits inside HSBC's own licence. Interim control retained:
`reviews/*CONTACT*.html` gitignored; share OUTSIDE HSBC as PDF only.

**WHAT CLEARS THIS:** (1) **files land** — `HSBC_MtUnivers_Latin-*.woff/.woff2` in
`knowledge/assets/fonts/` (this alone unblocks shareable material); (2) **brand confirms whether
Ultralight is in scope** — ⚠️ not a detail: the packs ship Th/Lt/Rg/Md/Bd ≡ 100/300/400/500/700, so
Ultralight is a **sixth weight below Thin → a change to the canon ramp → a TYPE RULING, not an asset
drop.** Expect it; don't discover it in a diff.

**Provenance corrections, kept loud (full record: `knowledge/_proforma/_TYPE-DECISIONS.md`
§ Blockers 1):** I struck this blocker as "false" and Dave caught it. And
`WebfontUserGuide-2024.pdf` is **generic Monotype guidance, not an entitlement record** — "we hold no
Latin webfont" rests on absence of files, not on any document.
